criteria.about: faithfulness to the English: no mistranslations, changed claims, wrong hypotheses or additions
nothing omitted or truncated: every paragraph, environment, equation and figure is there
standard Chinese mathematical terms, used consistently
natural academic Chinese rather than translationese
math, labels, references and macros kept exactly, and compilable
the judge's holistic score, not necessarily the mean

rows: Everything is there, and A reads the parenthetical the right way ('实时 \TeX 记录（除我本人与郭帅的报告之外的所有报告; ...）'). It keeps 'log GLSM' in English and renders 'my lectures' as '我的讲义' (lecture notes), which drifts slightly. The main flaw is punctuation: it uses half-width ', ' and '; ' all through the Chinese text, and there is a stray space in '温耀雄 指出'.

B is the clearest rendering. It splits the ambiguous parenthetical into two clauses: '除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告外，笔记均为现场用 TeX 记录；部分插图后来使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入'. That matches the intended meaning, since the author's and Guo's talks were not live-TeXed. The wording is concise and natural ('谨致歉意', '郭帅两场讲座', '实验性}转录'), and the LaTeX is clean.

C is faithful and complete, with good terminology ('对数 GLSM', '现场 \TeX{} 笔记', '\textbf{实验性} AI 转录稿'). It translates the parenthetical literally ('除我本人以及郭帅的讲座外，部分插图是事后用...插入的'), so in Chinese the exception seems to attach to the inserted figures rather than to the live-TeXing. The bare '注意，' is a little abrupt. The LaTeX is correct.

D is polished academic Chinese: '现场 TeX 速记稿', '在此一并致歉', '敬请告知'. Like C, it keeps the literal parenthetical '（除我本人以及郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是事后...补入的）', so it carries over the source's ambiguity about what the exception refers to. Nothing is omitted, and the LaTeX is fine.

E is complete and accurate apart from the same literal parenthetical as C and D. The register is too colloquial for an abstract: '都是用中文讲的', '补上的', '请告诉我'. It also moves the bold onto an adverb ('\textbf{试验性}地由 AI 生成的转写稿'), which changes the emphasis slightly but is acceptable.

F correctly says the live-TeXing excludes the author's and Guo's talks ('除我本人及郭帅的课程外均为现场录入'), but '课堂实时 \TeX{} 笔记' followed by '现场录入' is redundant. There is some drift: 'all of my other notes' becomes '我以往所有的笔记', and 'errors in my lectures' becomes '我本人讲义中的疏漏'. Calling the talks '课程/两节课程' fits a summer school less well than 报告/讲座.

G is complete but has several small faithfulness and style issues. 'later' becomes '会后' (after the conference), and '补充插入' is redundant. 'I did give' comes out as the translationese '我确实让', and the register is colloquial ('都是用中文讲的'). It keeps the literal, ambiguous parenthetical and has a stray space in '感谢 周祐正'.

Accurate, fluent and complete through every environment, with clean idiomatic phrasing such as "T 上的族的同构类所成的集合" and "它的作用是切出一个有限型的有界开子栈". The main visible defect is the English \text left in two displays ("E \text{ is a vector bundle on }", "isomorphism classes in"). Its 栈/广群/本征 choices are consistent, but "非交换局部化" means noncommutative, not non-abelian (the standard term is 非阿贝尔).

Complete, and its terminology is good and consistent (叠, 群胚, 良模空间, 固有, Noether 型). The translated display text is clumsy: "E \text{ 是如下空间上的向量丛：} C\times T" and "\{\text{其中的同构类：}\mf{X}(K)\}". The slope-stability definition is garbled into "满足 \[\mu(F)\leq\mu(E)\] 上述不等式（其中子层记为 F⊂E）", and "对某个充分大的整数…其中 m≫0" says the same thing twice. It also uses "非交换局部化" and adds @{} to the tabular spec.

The body text is faithful and uses the correct "非阿贝尔局部化". Several items are left untranslated: the optional arguments [informal], [Slope stability] and [S-equivalence], plus the English \text in two displays. Some phrasing is awkward ("T 上一族族的同构类的集合", "真（proper）的" repeated). Terminology is mixed: 良模空间 alongside "好的商", and diagonal rendered as "对角线" in the footnote.

The mathematical content is correct, but [informal] and the English \text in two displays are left untranslated. Many unnecessary English glosses are added ("图册（atlas）", "整体商（global quotient）", "斜率半稳定（slope semistable）", "收缩（contraction）"). Sentences are often translationese with appended locatives and parentheticals, e.g. "主 G-丛 E，定义在 A^1×C 上" and "滤过 f（B(p) 的滤过）…另一个滤过 f'（同为 B(p) 的滤过）". "推出函子" is wrong for pushforward (it should be 推前/前推).

Complete and fluent, and all display \text is translated naturally ("E \text{ 是 } C\times T \text{ 上的向量丛}", "\mf{X}(K)\text{ 中的同构类}"). Terminology is inconsistent: filtration is "滤链" throughout but "滤过对象的叠" for Filt, and stratum is both "Θ-层" and "分层片". It also uses "非交换局部化" for non-abelian. The headings use a bare Unicode "Θ-分层" instead of \(\Theta\), and it adds a small "（GIT）" gloss.

Complete and generally faithful. It handles the displays well, even reordering the F_{r,d} condition idiomatically ("对每个几何点 \bar t\to T，有 …"). It is cluttered with dozens of English glosses ("叠（stack）", "群胚（groupoid）", "惯性（inertia）", "伪函子（pseudofunctor）", …). Key terms are wrong: perfect complex is rendered "完备复形" (it should be 完美复形) and proper as "完备". There is also a grammatical slip, "被一个概形或代数空间所可表".

Reads naturally with good terms (叠, 群胚, 良模空间, 固有, 非阿贝尔, 过滤). However, all three Theta headings are typeset with lowercase "$\theta$-分层", a visible symbol error. There are accuracy slips: "指定 T 上一族同构类的集合" misreads "isomorphism classes of families", and the footnote drops "locally" ("大致上是有限表现的"). It also has a typo, "带有所左 G-作用", and leaves "atlas" in English.

Faithful and complete. Terminology is standard and consistent ('图卡' for chart, '细的', '鬼层'), and it keeps '泛点' (generic point) apart from '一般点' (general point). Weak spots: the English \text{...} inside math ('if there exists', 'is invertible outside', 'if') is left untranslated, and the 'Cone' morphism sentence is clumsy ('由满足……使得……的映射组成').

The most natural prose of the set (e.g. '对数几何将函数替换为函数连同其在边界上的消失方式这一数据'). But it renders chart as '图', which collides with '下图'/'交换图' for diagrams, and it uses '一般点' for both generic and general points ('在一般点或一般光滑点'). The translated \text is awkward ('f \text{ 在如下集合外可逆：} D'), and it adds '额外的' to 'S 上没有额外的对数结构'.

Complete but literal ('或者我们退化目标', many '我们看到'). Real errors: the FKato theorem becomes '对数光滑的对数积（integral）映射', and 'which also define log structures' gains a spurious '典范'. Chart is '图表', the same word as diagram ('是图表，且图表……交换'). It switches from '精细' to 'fine 对数概形' in the punctured-curve part, leaves the English \text untranslated, and changes \(w, N_w\) to \((w, N_w)\).

Integral is translated as '对数积' ('称 P 是对数积（integral）的', '有限生成、精细、对数积、饱和'), which is wrong. From the Log curves subsection on, the translation falls back to English ('fine 的（甚至是 fine saturated 的）', 'integral 的', 'saturated 的'), so terminology is badly inconsistent. Also 'ghost 层', '交数' for intersection numbers, chart as '图表' clashing with diagrams, and English \text left inside math. The meaning is otherwise mostly preserved.

Accurate, complete and fluent. It uses the distinct term '卡' for chart, so charts never clash with '图' for diagrams, and the rest of the terminology is consistent ('精细', '尖锐', '幽灵层（ghost sheaf）'). It also translates every \text cleanly ('f \text{ 在 } D \text{ 之外可逆}', '\text{ 若存在 } s \in P \text{ 使得 }'). Minor: '一般点' also stands for generic point, and '资料' for data is a slightly regional choice.

Generally accurate, with good '泛型点' for generic point. But colimit is rendered three times as '上极限' (which means limsup), once with a stray Japanese kana: '如下图表の上极限（colimit）'. Heavy parenthetical English glosses clutter the text, and there are small additions ('integral，或满足消去律的', '特化映射（或泛化映射）'). '前稳定' and '相切阶' are less standard than 预稳定 and 接触阶.

Fine is translated as '有限的' throughout ('Q 是有限幺半群', '有限对数概形', '有限生成的、有限的、整的、饱和的'). That reads as 'finite' and changes the mathematical claims. Other nonstandard or garbled choices: '法相交除子', '扇形结构' for the fan, '消没' for vanish, '函数的资料以及它们在边界上如何消没'. The Kato theorem condition is mangled as '挠部分的阶是在 X 上可逆的有限群'. The math and environments are intact.

Faithful and complete. It gets the hard spots right, e.g. it keeps X as the toric variety in the oscillating-integral setup ("对我们而言，\(X\) 将是环簇") and uses standard terms such as "胀子方程", "Lefschetz 顶针", "祖先/后裔". Weak points: it mixes "镜面对称/镜面定理" with "镜像族/镜像五次三维流形", leaves "tautological 类/关系" in English, uses "栈" rather than 叠, and uses "本征的" for proper. Math and labels are intact; only the cite optional argument and the \text labels are translated.

The most concise and natural prose, e.g. "单个 Gromov--Witten 不变量就很难计算，因此我们转而研究一个更加困难的问题". Small condensations: "already known to Givental" becomes "Givental 已知的一个结果". Several term choices are non-standard: "伸缩子方程/伸缩子平移" for dilaton, "Lefschetz 膜" for thimble, and "拉格朗日锥" alongside "Lagrange 乘子". It uses 叠 and 重言类 well. The caption ends with an ASCII period after Chinese text; otherwise the math is preserved.

Complete, but it has real accuracy slips. It makes the mirror family toric ("对我们而言该镜像族是环面簇"; the English means X is toric), garbles "up to various prefactors" as "在各种前因子范围内", and translates thimble as "Lefschetz 喉管". Terminology drifts mid-unit, from "Frobenius 流形/Gromov-Witten" to "弗罗贝尼乌斯流形/格罗莫夫-威滕理论" and from Hodge to "霍奇丛", and it uses "先祖" for ancestors. The prose is translationese ("对 \(\alpha_i \in H^*(X)\)。", "若 V = H^*(X) 对 Calabi-Yau 三维簇 X", footnote "这是因为我展开"). It leaves \text{forget map} in English.

Math is preserved almost exactly. Accuracy problems: the same toric misreading ("对我们而言该镜像族是环面簇"), "MSP 群" (a mathematical group) for the MSP research group, "Lefschetz 闭链" for thimble, and a redundant "这给出（分次）维数 χ(V)，也就是 V 的（分次）维数". Heavy transliteration ("格罗莫夫–威滕", "卡拉比–丘", "霍奇丛", "黎曼–罗赫") is applied inconsistently: later it writes "Hodge 丛", "Euler 向量场", "Riemann-Roch". It also uses "先祖" for ancestors, keeps \text{forget map} in English, and changes $R$ to \(R\) in the headings.

Accurate and natural, with good choices such as "紧合的" (proper), "平展覆叠" (étale cover), "Lefschetz 顶针", "MSP 小组", "数值有效（nef）". It renders the toric remark sensibly ("这里我们只考虑环面簇的情形") and moves the Teleman formula after its sentence without loss. Weaknesses: "伸缩子方程" for dilaton; it switches between Gromov--Witten and Gromov-Witten; and the source spacing around inline math is inconsistent ("计算J 函数", "\(X\)是" in early sections, spaced later).

Very fluent, idiomatic restructuring (e.g. "只要无穷求和有意义，我们就定义" placed before the display). It mistranslates tautological as "典范类/典范关系", which collides with "典范坐标" (canonical coordinates). Small additions: "传播到了后续的许多文献中", "尾项（平移）". It adds a lot of English glosses in parentheses ("（evaluation morphism）", "（quantum connection）", ...). It adds or removes final punctuation inside about 20 display equations, so the math source is not preserved exactly.

Complete and generally correct, but it has the toric misreading ("对我们而言该镜像族是一个环簇") and misplaces a parenthetical so that the invariants look like ψ-classes ("亏格零 Gromov-Witten 不变量（即 \(\psi\)-类）"). Terminology is uneven: "膨胀子位移", "Lefschetz thimble" left in English, "节点", "五次超曲面". The style is literal ("回忆前面的 Hodge 丛 CohFT。回忆它由公式..."). It drops some display-final periods, changes \text{even} to \text{偶}, and adds braces in $\{\Mbar_{g,n}\}$.

Faithful and complete, environment by environment. It uses "层片" for stratum, which avoids clashing with 层 = sheaf, and translates the align text as "一个 4 维的直和项". Small blemishes: "满足 Verdier 对偶" is left after the display's period, \text{ relevant} stays in English, and "W-torsor" is left untranslated.

Concise and readable, but it has a structural error: "满足 Verdier 对偶性。" is moved inside the perverse-sheaf definition environment, so the six-functor sentence is truncated and the definition starts with a stray clause. It also drops content: "a summand of dimension 4" becomes just "维数为 4", and "Unfortunately" is dropped twice. Calling strata "相关层"/"稠密层" confuses them with sheaves.

Accurate, with good terms ("真映射", "W-主齐性空间", "中间扩张"). It leaves "a summand of dimension 4" and "relevant" in English in the displayed math, and keeps the display period before "满足 Verdier 对偶". Minor wording slips include "点集的希尔伯特概形" and the colloquial "与其解析化打交道".

Fluent, and it handles the Verdier sentence best: "并满足 Verdier 对偶，对偶函子为" with the display intact. The terminology is weaker: "泛有限" for generically finite, the truncated "W-扭" for torsor, and "相关层" for stratum. The align text "a summand of dimension 4" is left in English.

Complete and accurate. It even fixes the punctuation by dropping the period from the D_Y display before "满足 Verdier 对偶", and translates the align text "一个 4 维的直和项" and the subscript "相关". The term choices are less common: "紧合" for proper and "W-旋子" for torsor. It consistently omits spaces around inline math, with one glitch, "的crepant 消解".

Complete, but it adds a lot of English glosses ("（six functor formalism）", "（heart）", "（perverse cohomology）"...) that clutter the text. Some terms are wrong or nonstandard: "同调平凡解消（crepant resolution）" is incorrect, and "完备映射" is used for proper. Small additions such as "稠密开层" and "于是不妨取" appear, and the theorem title uses a literal "Künneth" instead of K\"unneth.

Complete, but inconsistent: two theorem titles stay in English ("K\"unneth formula", "Leray/Serre spectral sequence"), and it mixes "relevant 分层" with "相关". "存在奇异的 crepant 解消" mistranslates 'crepant resolution of singularities' as a singular resolution. "分层" is also used for a stratum, and "上式消失" for 'vanishes' is translationese.

Faithful and complete: every environment, both figures and the commented-out block are kept, and the math is identical to the source. The main weakness is terminology. Pushforward is rendered as the pushout term "推出" throughout ("沿本征态射的推出", "等变 Euler 特征定义为推出", "然后计算推出"), Euler characteristic is given as "Euler 特征", and it uses 栈 where 叠 is expected. It also adds Chinese names the source does not give ("李元斌–瞿枫" for Lee--Qu).

Concise, idiomatic Chinese with standard terms (叠, 推前, 固有态射, Euler 示性数, 伪不变量/主干). There are small meaning shifts: "unique rational curve" becomes "一条孤立的有理曲线", it inserts "对不同的输入" and the hedge "可能有", and it narrows "in this situation" to "在后一种情形中". On the LaTeX side, it wraps two align* displays in unrequested "{\small ...}" and leaves three lines that begin with a stray "。" after a display.

Accurate and complete, with intact math and figures. It keeps several terms in English without need ("orbifold 陈特征标", "fake 不变量", "stem 理论"), fully transliterates "格罗莫夫--威滕", and spaces K理论 / K 理论 / DM叠 inconsistently. Some sentences follow the English word order around displays, e.g. "并计算 [display] 通过虚拟局部化。" and "Lee 的公式计算关联函数 [display] 通过展开 [display]".

Generally faithful and complete. Inertia stack is mistranslated as "惰性叠" (it should be 惯性叠), and the rendering of "we should think of x = T_1" is ungrammatical ("其中我们应将 x = T_1 且 u(x) = ..." has no verb). Terminology is inconsistent: 推前 and 前推 both appear, as do 黎曼--罗赫 and Riemann-Roch, plus 托德类 and 弗罗贝尼乌斯. Seven lines start with a stray "。" or "，" after displays, and some displays are reordered relative to the source.

The most natural and precise of the seven, with smooth restructuring ("量子 K 理论对 V_1,...,V_n ∈ K(X) 给出数", "则 ζ 由“g 以特征值 ζ 作用在 L_1 上”这一条件定义") and consistent terms (叠, 前推, 紧合, 覆叠, 伪/茎). Minor points: threefold is rendered as "三维流形" rather than 三维簇, it leaves "Adelic 刻画" in English, it renders "naively" as "粗略地说", and it adds Chinese names for Lee/Qu. Every inline math expression is written with no space against the surrounding Chinese; this is consistent but unusual.

It reads fluently, but it renders both "proper" and "perfect" as 完备 ("沿完备态射的前推", "带有完备障碍理论的完备 DM 叠", "完备复形"), which erases a mathematical distinction and makes the statements wrong. It adds many English glosses in parentheses ("（string equation）", "（loop space）", "（multiple cover formulae）") and writes "重覆盖" for multiple cover. It also silently deletes the roughly 225-line commented-out figure and explanation block, so the compiled output is unchanged but the source differs.

Half-width ASCII commas, colons and parentheses are used throughout the Chinese text (no full-width ， at all), mixed with full-width 。. The terminology has errors: the heading typo "公理性性质", gravitational descendants as "引力下降部分", gerbe as "μ_2-丛胚", perfect as "完全复形/完全态射", and "扭转扇形". Several sentences are garbled: "并分解使得 [display] 使得对固定的 i", "从它在 [display] 单位根 ζ 处的 Laurent 展开中", and "它定义在模空间 [display] 它由公式", which is missing 上 and 定义.

Faithful and complete throughout, and it reads naturally, e.g. "代价是鼓出一条有理尾" and "且 \((v_1, v_2)\) 处处非零" (correct for 'nonvanishing'). Small terminology quirks: "沿 \(\mc{Z}\) 的层片的迭代爆破" for strata, "挠子" for torsor, and it alternates between "五次三维流形" and "五次流形". It leaves the English inside \text{ fixed and ... is not a common zero}, but all math, labels and cites are byte-identical.

Concise and idiomatic ("可将这些模空间看作在虚意义下彼此双有理", "注意该态射远非分离"), with \text{} translated and "五次三维簇" used consistently. Small liberties: it adds "其仿射锥原点" in the lci remark, and in the master-space conditions it attaches "对所有有理尾 \(C'\)" to the v=0 clause, not to the sum inequality. LaTeX changes: it adds two {\small ...} wrappers and leaves stray full stops at the start of a line after displays ("\]\n。具体地", "。注意该态射"). It also mixes "阿贝尔群" with "非交换".

It translates the nonvanishing condition as "\((v_1, v_2)\) 不恒为零" (not identically zero), which weakens the hypothesis. The environment titles "[Second toy example]" and "[Another toy example]" are left untranslated, and "Hassett\textquotesingle s 的" and "Hassett's 的" leave the English possessive in. The prose is translationese ("于是我们可以计算 \[...\] 通过将计算转移到另一个不动点轨迹"), and it alternates between "五次三维簇" and "五次超曲面".

Generally accurate and readable, with sensible choices like "真（proper）" and "\((v_1, v_2)\) 不全为零". There are small slips: "定义域也被参数化了" adds "也", and "镜像变换" is less standard than 镜像映射. Some English is left in: "Lian-Liu-Yau", "\(\C^{\times}\)-torsor", "Hassett\textquotesingle s 加权模空间", and the \text{} in \(F_{\star,d}\). Two display equations are followed by stray full stops at the start of a line ("。特别地", "。我们还看到").

Very accurate. It handles the quantifier in the master-space definition cleanly ("且对所有有理尾\(C'\)有 \[...\]"), renders nonvanishing correctly as "处处不为零", and translates the \text{} ("不动且"). The terminology is unusual and inconsistent: "壁穿越" and "壁与腔" where most of the literature says 越墙 and 墙与室, and it moves between "五次三维流形（quintic）", "五次超曲面" and "Grassmann 流形". From the Master space subsection on, it drops the spaces between Chinese and inline math ("考虑\(\P^n\)上"), which does not match the first half.

It has several substantive errors. A general point "在 \(\C^{\times}\)-作用下保持不动" (it is not fixed). "V 是仿射空间" should say V is affine, not affine space. "带有完备障碍理论的完备 DM 叠" renders 'perfect obstruction theory' as 完备 and so conflates it with proper. It also adds content ("（即结点和标记点）", an extra \(C'\) and \(\xi\)), clutters the prose with English glosses ("尾（tail）", "冒泡（bubble）", "基点（basepoint）"), changes \xrightarrow{\text{\'et}} to \text{平展}, and moves punctuation inside several displays.

The content is mostly accurate ("为有限集且不含特殊点", "完美阻碍理论"), but it uses half-width ASCII punctuation (",", ";", ":", "(") throughout the Chinese prose, mixed with full-width "。". It drops the curve name in "考虑一条带有一个标记的节点曲线" (missing \(C\)) and leaves four stray full stops at the start of a line after displays ("。它属于", "。特别地", "。注意这个态射", "。我们还看到"). Its terminology is colloquial or nonstandard: "有理尾巴", "节点" for 结点, "磨光参数", "\(\C^{\times}\)-主齐性空间".

Faithful throughout, with no environments, equations or TikZ code lost. The theorem and corollary statements are rendered correctly (e.g. "没有奇次上同调的 Fano 四维簇 X", "上述关于 (X, V) 的猜想蕴含 Z 的 Yamaguchi-Yau 有限生成"). Terminology is the weak point: it uses "栈" rather than the requested 叠 throughout, and "本征" for proper ("本征 DM 栈", "本征临界轨迹"), which is uncommon in algebraic geometry. The prose is natural and has consistent full-width punctuation.

Concise, idiomatic Chinese ("顶点分为两类……其半边要么全部向下，要么有一些向上") with good choices: 叠, 固有, 丰沛, 二分图. The content is complete and mostly correct, but the opening sentence is mistranslated as "它在预期的余维数上定义了一个光滑的零截面". "不是真的" for "not proper" reads as "not true". Solid and accurate, with good terms (叠, 真, 靶, 虚类, 丰富) and helpful English glosses such as "装饰热带型（decorated tropical type）". The most polished version. Faithful and complete, but it uses "专有" for proper everywhere ("不是专有的", "专有 DM 叠"), which is wrong. It also uses "充裕" for ample and "锥流形间隙条件" for the conifold gap. It has real mathematical mistranslations: "Z 在余维数 1 处光滑" ("smooth in codimension 1", which is a different notion) and "Z 在期望余维数处光滑" in the lemma. Polished, natural prose that handles the displays well, e.g. reordering to '其各分量被 Picard-Fuchs 算子 \[...\] 零化' and removing the stray period. Two meaning slips: 'open in general' became '在一般情形仍是公开的' (公开 means public), and the footnote's 'separate statements' became '彼此独立的陈述'.

Concise, idiomatic style with consistent terms ('锥形奇点间隙', '余项图', '过墙', '虚圈'). The meaning is mostly faithful, but terminology wavers: '格罗莫夫–威滕理论' and 'Gromov-Witten' are mixed, 'rest graphs' is both '其余图' and '剩余图', 'bipartite' is both '二部' and '二分', and 'rubber' is left in English in one place but '橡胶' elsewhere. Generally accurate and readable, with helpful English glosses. Terminology is inconsistent, though: conifold appears as '锥点', 'conifold（锥奇点）' and plain 'conifold'; gap is both '缝隙' and '间隙'; correlator is both '关联函数' and '关联子'; normalized is both '正规化' and '规范化'; and one place mixes scripts, '格罗莫夫--Witten'. The most consistently faithful and natural translation. Displays are restructured cleanly ('由 \[...\] 给出', periods removed), and 'separate statements' is rendered correctly as '另外的命题'. Terms are standard and stable ('锥形奇点间隙', '剩余图', '壁穿越', '源曲线', '驻相'). Minor points: 'rubber' is left in English, \text{ 二部图} vs \text{ 二部} differ between the two sums, '首项' and '领头' are mixed, and there is no spacing between CJK text and inline math (harmless).

Fluent and complete, with extensive English glosses ('多重覆盖变换（multicover transformation）', '余图（rest graphs）') and a well-formed '\text{当 } i \leq ... \text{ 时}'. Some term choices are off: 'level' became '能级（level）' (an energy level), 'identification' became '认同', and the nonstandard '原生不变量' is used for primary invariants. '锥流形点' and '全纯模糊性' are usable but unusual. One sentence reads awkwardly: '我们将使用全纯模糊性上的两类条件来源'.

Complete, with math intact, but it has terminology and typing errors. 'Orbifold point' is rendered throughout as '轨道点' (orbit point) instead of '轨形点'. 'Rational descendant insertions' is mistyped twice as '带理后代插入' / '理后代插入' (missing 有). The 'residue pattern' of the mod-5 rule became '留数模式' (complex-analytic residue). It mixes '五次超曲面' with '五次三维流形' (table caption), uses '含糊性' for ambiguity, and adds a stray space in the title '结构 （郭帅）'.

All math and refs match the source, and the prose is careful and natural, e.g. "与普通的锥形点奇异性不同——后者的亏格 g 首项极点阶为 2g-2" and "拟设", "带框架的 R-矩阵", "Lefschetz 顶针". Weak spots are "已解消的锥形点" for resolved conifold and the bare "环 Calabi--Yau"/"环图" for toric. Hyphens in names became en-dashes (Gromov--Witten), which is harmless.

Complete and concise, with the math intact. Some choices are off: ansatz becomes "表达式猜想" (it reads as a conjecture), thimble becomes "Lefschetz 膜", "The interesting point" becomes "关键是", and "一亏格/零亏格" is used. "该交换对应 (2,3) 与 (3,2) 极小模型之间的对应" is clumsy.

Faithful overall, but "配对" is mistyped twice as "配为" ("配为" and "配为对角形式"). "不是真的" for 'not proper' reads as 'is not true'. Terminology is mixed: "conifold 奇点" alongside "解消锥形", and "remodeling" and "Lefschetz thimble" are left in English. The sentence "我们由量子微分方程 [display ending in '.'] 确定 R-矩阵" breaks after the display, and there is a stray space in "许景毅和 张庆生".

The meaning is accurate and readable, but Gromov-Witten is transliterated as "格罗莫夫–威滕" next to Latin Eynard-Orantin and Riemann-Roch. Accurate and fluent, with good terms: "紧合" for proper, "拟设", "Lefschetz 顶针", "标架". Minor issues are "三维流形" for threefold (簇 is better in AG), "remodeling 猜想" left in English, and the awkward "有趣的是点 q→1/p^2". Spaces around inline math were dropped throughout, but consistently.

Complete with correct math, but 'not proper' is mistranslated as "不是专有的". Many English glosses are added in parentheses (semiprojective, ansatz, scaled string coupling, double-scaling limit, framed R-matrix, fundamental bidifferential, Lefschetz thimbles), which clutters the text. The prose leans toward translationese, e.g. "这就是为什么当前情形未被现有文献所涵盖的原因" and "我们将有理性约化为了".

Several term errors: "Calabi-Yau 型" for Calabi-Yau form, "扇形" for fan, "交数" for intersection numbers, and a Unicode "Γ 函数". In four places the verb is moved after a display that ends in a period ("由 [ … . ] 给出。", "从量子微分方程 [ … . ] 出发来确定"), so the output reads badly. The parenthetical separates the live-TeX exceptions from later figure insertion with '除我本人与郭帅的报告之外的所有报告; 其中部分图', preserving the intended distinction despite its fragmentary syntax. '我的讲义中的任何错误' shifts errors in the author's lectures to errors in written lecture notes. All sentences and the abstract environment are present, and the bold emphasis is retained; mixed ASCII punctuation and the space in '温耀雄 指出' need minor polishing.

The explicit sentence '除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告外，笔记均为现场用 TeX 记录；部分插图后来使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入' clearly preserves both the recording exceptions and later figure insertion. '本人讲座中的任何错误' and '其他所有笔记' faithfully retain the scope of the apology and Claude's access to the other notes. Every sentence and acknowledgment is represented, and the abstract environment and bold emphasis are intact.

The parenthetical '除我本人以及郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是事后使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入的' appears to qualify figure insertion rather than clearly exempting those talks from live recording. Otherwise, '我的全部其他笔记' and the request to report '文风不一致或任何错误' preserve the source accurately and read naturally. All content, the abstract environment, and the bold emphasis are retained.

In '现场 TeX 笔记（除我自己和郭帅的报告外，部分图片是后来用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补上的）', the exceptions appear attached to later image insertion rather than live recording. The complete abstract and acknowledgments are present, with the environment and bold emphasis preserved.

The phrase '除我本人及郭帅的课程外均为现场录入' correctly makes the live-recording exceptions explicit. However, '我本人讲义中的疏漏' changes errors in the author's lectures into omissions or oversights in written notes, and '我以往所有的笔记' introduces a temporal scope absent from 'all of my other notes'. The alternation between '课程' and '报告' is less precise, but all source sentences, the abstract environment, and the bold emphasis remain present.

The wording '除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是在会后' leaves the live-recording exceptions unclear and narrows the source's unspecified 'later' to after the event. '实验性地由 AI 生成的转录' is understandable but less natural than describing an experimental transcription, and '现场 TeX 记录笔记' is redundant. All substantive content and acknowledgments are represented, and the abstract environment and bold emphasis are preserved.

Faithfully preserves the stability hypotheses, Rees construction, localization finiteness conditions, and HN criteria, with every environment, diagram, and equation present. Phrases such as “在非典范同构意义下唯一” are clear and natural, although “具有可表（由代数空间）对角态射” is syntactically awkward. The vector-bundle and coarse-moduli displays retain English explanatory text, so the Chinese translation still needs a small editorial pass.

The strongest overall version: it preserves all mathematical conditions and all environments, equations, diagrams, labels, and citation keys, while also translating the explanatory text inside displays. “对角态射拟紧、拟分离” clearly renders the qcqs hypothesis, and “除有限多个…外均无上同调” accurately conveys the acyclicity condition. Minor editing is needed for the awkward display formulations “是如下空间上的向量丛：” and “其中的同构类：”, and the slope-stability sentence unnecessarily repeats “上述不等式”.

Mathematical statements, quantifiers, and formulas are faithfully retained, including the full Rees construction and both HN conditions; no environment or diagram is missing. The prose has conspicuous editing defects, notably “一族族的同构类的集合” and “或等价地等价于”. Expressions such as “非真的标量稳定化子” are awkward without the earlier English gloss, while “好的商” is less precise as terminology than a consistently named good quotient. English explanatory text in displays and headings such as “Slope stability” remain untranslated.

The translation retains every environment, equation, diagram, and reference, and accurately carries over the localization and HN hypotheses. Both Theta-stratum definitions use the wording “中连通分支之并” immediately after the ambient stack, suggesting components of that stack rather than of its filtration stack, although the displayed inclusion remains correct. Calling the pushforward “推出函子” is a terminology error, and “非真的标量稳定化子” is awkward Chinese. English explanatory text remains in several displays despite otherwise readable academic prose.

A consistently faithful and complete translation, preserving all mathematical hypotheses, environments, diagrams, formulas, labels, and citation keys. “存在万有族”, “数乘自同构”, and the explicit rendering of the isomorphism classes inside the coarse-moduli display are clear choices; the Rees and HN discussions are also easy to follow. Minor stylistic unevenness remains in “忘掉自同构” and the literal opening “一个合理的代数叠”, but these do not obscure the mathematics.

All source environments, formulas, diagrams, labels, and citation keys are retained, and the Rees and HN arguments are fully translated. However, “完备复形” and later “是完备的” repeatedly render perfect complex as completeness, obscuring a specific technical hypothesis even though the initial English gloss helps identify the intended meaning. The prose is generally readable but includes awkward constructions such as “被一个概形或代数空间所可表” and “容有泛族”. Numerous English glosses are useful for identification but make the exposition heavier than B or E.

All environments, diagrams, and displayed equations are present, but the final footnote changes locally of finite presentation to “有限表现”, dropping the local qualification and strengthening the hypothesis. The opening phrase “一族同构类的集合” also obscures that the classes are classes of families, and “带有所左” is an obvious proofreading defect. “过滤” is understandable but less conventional here than 滤过, and several sentences remain literal or repetitive. The headings introduce lowercase theta in place of the uppercase Theta used throughout the mathematical definitions, creating a notation inconsistency despite otherwise preserved formulas and references.

Faithfully preserves the mathematical statements, including the unique lifting condition and the puncturing conditions, with consistent terms such as “整的” and “泛化映射”. All environments, equations, diagrams, labels, citation keys, and the figure are retained. The prose is sometimes awkward, notably “考虑把 ... 的图卡” and “由满足 ... 使得” in the cone-morphism definition, and the short English prose inside formulas remains untranslated.

A clear, largely faithful translation with dependable terminology such as “精细幺半群”, “代数叠”, and “接触阶”. It retains every environment, formula, diagram, citation key, and the figure, and correctly keeps the Zariski-log-structure hypothesis on X. Minor issues include the interpretive replacement of singular locus by “奇异曲线所在部分” and the clumsy formula wording “在如下集合外可逆：”.

Complete and structurally faithful, with all mathematical environments, equations, diagrams, labels, and citation keys retained. However, integral unexpectedly becomes “对数积（integral）” in the canonical-family theorem despite being “整的” earlier, and generalization maps become “广义化映射”. The phrase “在带有 Zariski 对数结构的 ... 上对数光滑” attaches the Zariski condition to the base rather than X, changing a theorem hypothesis. Literal constructions such as “分解通过” and untranslated formula prose also need editing.

All source environments, formulas, diagrams, labels, citation keys, and the figure are present, and most explanatory prose is readable. The recurring translation of integral as “对数积” is a substantial terminology defect, followed by inconsistent switches to untranslated “integral” and “fine”. The theorem on cone complexes also misplaces the Zariski-log-structure assumption through “在带 Zariski 对数结构的 ... 上对数光滑”. These problems require substantive terminology revision despite the preserved formulas.

Consistently faithful and readable, using terms such as “精细的”, “相伴对数结构”, and “穿孔化” while preserving all quantifiers and puncturing conditions. The cone-complex theorem correctly says “在 ... 上对数光滑，并带有 Zariski 对数结构”, keeping the latter condition on X. Every environment, equation, diagram, label, citation key, and the figure is retained, and the prose inside formulas is translated. A few expressions, including “底族” and the repeated “资料”, could be polished, but no substantive mathematical mistranslation was found.

Preserves the mathematical content and all environments, equations, diagrams, labels, citation keys, and the figure. However, colimit is repeatedly rendered as “上极限” instead of the standard categorical “余极限”, and “如下图表の上极限” contains an obvious stray Japanese character. The added “特化映射（或泛化映射）” blurs the distinction between the two terms, while frequent English glosses make the prose heavy. The Zariski hypothesis and the final concavity and rational-slope conditions are correctly retained.

Complete, with the source formulas, environments, diagrams, labels, citation keys, and figure retained. Fine is systematically mistranslated as “有限的”, producing misleading claims such as “幺半群 ... 是有限的” for pushouts and “有限子幺半群” in the puncturing example. Other problematic terms include “法相交除子” for normal crossings divisor and “磨光参数” for smoothing parameter. It also attaches the Zariski-log-structure condition to the base in the cone-complex theorem, so substantial correction is needed.

The translation is complete and generally fluent, preserving the mirror theorem, CohFT axioms, reconstruction computations, and both figures. However, translating properness as “是本征的” misidentifies the geometric property used to define GW invariants. “Lagrange 锥” and “KdV 族” are less precise terminology than Lagrangian cone and KdV hierarchy, although the accompanying formulas remain intact.

This is a consistently clear and faithful translation, with appropriate choices such as “固有的”, “Deligne--Mumford 叠”, “重言类”, and “幂等基”. All environments, equations, figures, and reference keys are retained; translating the even/odd annotations in the R-matrix coefficients preserves their meaning. Minor weaknesses include the unconventional “3-旋曲线” and the opening mirror-symmetry history, which describes the conversion of the counting problem without explicitly retaining that the curve numbers were predictions.

The full mathematical development and LaTeX structures are retained, but the prose needs more editing than the other versions. In the oscillating-integral introduction, “该镜像族是环面簇” transfers the toric assumption from X to the mirror family, while “Lefschetz 喉管” is an unsuitable rendering of a thimble. “在各种前因子范围内” also obscures equality up to prefactors, and the resulting fixed-point restriction sentence is difficult to parse.

All definitions, theorems, examples, formulas, and figures are present, and much of the Chinese is readable. However, “MSP 群” turns a research group into an apparent mathematical group, and “Lefschetz 闭链” incorrectly describes a thimble as a closed chain. The phrase “该镜像族是环面簇” also attaches the toric hypothesis to the mirror family instead of X; wording such as “这给出（分次）维数 ... 也就是 ...（分次）维数” adds avoidable repetition.

This is a complete, accurate, and readable translation, especially in the graph action and final R-matrix calculation. Phrases such as “可以按其首项是哪一个” clearly express how the Lagrange-multiplier branches are distinguished, and all mathematical displays and reference keys are preserved. Minor editorial issues include using “赋值态射” for evaluation morphism, the unusual “平展覆叠” for an etale cover, and occasional informal wording such as “粘起来”.

The translation preserves the entire unit, including the long genus-one calculation and both diagrams, and its explanations are generally easy to follow. The recurring translations “典范类（tautological class）” and “典范关系（tautological relations）” confuse tautological terminology with canonical terminology; “Lagrange 锥” is also less precise than Lagrangian cone. Numerous added English glosses make the prose heavier, and prestable varies between “预稳定” and “前稳定”, although the mathematical formulas remain faithful.

This is a complete translation with intact equations, figures, and references, and it appropriately retains “Lefschetz thimble” in English. However, “对我们而言该镜像族是一个环簇” assigns the toric condition to the mirror family rather than X. The placement of “即 ψ-类” after “Gromov-Witten 不变量” makes the invariants themselves appear to be psi classes, and phrases such as “不接收尾部贡献” retain an awkwardly literal English structure.

The mathematical statements, hypotheses, proof, and all Springer examples are faithfully retained, including the final four-dimensional summand as “维的直和项”. Terminology such as “局部系”, “反常层”, and “中间延拓” is consistent, although “本征态射” is a less conventional choice for proper morphism. Phrases such as “但在到达那里之前” and “对所有层片…变动” are noticeably literal; equations, environments, and reference keys are preserved.

Most mathematics is translated accurately and concisely, with clear choices such as “固有满态射”, “相关层”, and “保持典范类的奇点消解”. However, “满足 Verdier 对偶性” is incorrectly placed inside the following perverse-sheaf definition, leaving the preceding paragraph unfinished and changing the environment contents. The final decomposition renders the four-dimensional summand merely as “维数为” followed by 4, omitting the identification as a summand. All main environments and reference keys remain present, and the extra alignment line break preserves the equation.

All environments, equations, and examples are retained, and the semi-small inequality and support/cosupport conditions are faithfully translated. Calling the Hilbert scheme of points “点集的希尔伯特概形” misleadingly suggests sets of points rather than finite subschemes, while “t”-structure terminology uses the less standard “核心” for heart. Expressions such as “需要与其解析化打交道” and “由于…是真的” are awkward, and the final phrase “a summand of dimension” remains untranslated.

This is a faithful and generally polished translation, with precise choices such as “泛有限的真映射” and “t”-structure “的心”, and a well-formed introduction to the Verdier-duality functor. Every definition, theorem, proof, example, equation, and reference key is retained. Minor editorial issues include the abbreviated torsor term “扭” and the untranslated final phrase “a summand of dimension”; neither changes the mathematical claims.

The translation preserves all mathematical content and clearly describes the Whitney fibration as “纤维为（可能奇异的）簇”, avoiding ambiguity about where singularities occur. Choices such as “反常层”, “中间延拓”, and the final “维的直和项” are accurate, and all environments, formulas, and reference keys are retained. The torsor rendering “旋子” is less familiar than 扭子 or 主齐性空间, and occasional wording such as “一串…构成的链” could be tightened.

All environments, equations, references, and the complete Springer discussion are retained, with useful terminology such as “局部系” and “支集条件”. The substantial error is “同调平凡解消（crepant resolution）”: crepancy concerns the canonical divisor, not homological triviality, so this introduces a different mathematical property. The repeated English glosses and wording such as “这一范畴容有” also make the prose heavier and less natural, although the LaTeX structure remains intact.

All environments, formulas, reference keys, and final representation-theoretic conclusions are present. However, “存在奇异的 crepant 解消” mistranslates a resolution of singularities as a singular resolution, and “唯一的 relevant 分层” confuses an individual stratum with a stratification. Terms such as “固有态射” and “交复形” are appropriate, but untranslated theorem headings and the mixed-language relevant phrase reduce editorial consistency.

The mathematical statements and hypotheses are largely faithful, and every active environment, equation, figure, and reference is retained. However, proper pushforward becomes “沿本征态射的推出”: “本征” is inappropriate here, and “推出” risks confusion with a pushout; evaluation is also rendered “赋值映射”. The prose is generally readable, although “KdV 族” loses the specificity of hierarchy and “五次三维簇的对应猜想于” is awkward.

This is the clearest overall version, with effective terminology such as “固有态射的推前”, “万有余切线丛”, and “KdV 层级”, and concise explanations of localization and the adelic decomposition. One fidelity slip changes the source's unique rational curve to “一条孤立的有理曲线”, while “超椭圆部分” is less precise than hyperelliptic locus. All active environments, formulas, figures, labels, and citation keys are preserved.

The translation preserves the mathematical content and all active environments, equations, figures, and reference keys, using sound terms such as “完美复形”, “求值映射”, and “KdV 层级”. Readability suffers from literal constructions such as “其中我们应把” the two identities “视为等同”, and the stranded “通过虚拟局部化” after the localization formula. “五次对应” is also an underexplained rendering of the quintic correspondence, although leaving fake and stem in English is reasonable.

The mathematical claims, both adelic propositions, the pluri-Hodge recursions, and all figures and references are retained. Terminology is less consistent than in the strongest versions: the earlier “惯性叠” becomes “惰性叠”, and hierarchy is reduced to “KdV 族”. Several sentences need editing, especially “其中我们应将” followed directly by identities and “五次三维簇的对应于” followed by a citation.

This version gives fluent, faithful explanations, notably “其中应理解为” in the KdV setup and the careful description of the black component as an “极大连通分支”. Its main weaknesses are terminology: evaluation maps become “赋值映射”, and “KdV 族” is less precise than hierarchy. All active paragraphs, environments, equations, figures, labels, and citation keys are present, with no substantive mathematical alteration detected.

The prose is generally clear and the explanatory English glosses often help, but “沿完备态射的前推” translates proper morphisms with the same Chinese term later used for perfect morphisms. Related choices “完备复形” and “完备障碍理论” obscure the perfectness condition, while “KdV 谱系” is nonstandard in this context. Despite its shorter file, every active environment, formula, and figure is retained; the large deletion is commented-out material, and the active TikZ diagram and reference keys are preserved.

The formulas, hypotheses, active environments, figures, and reference keys remain intact, but technical vocabulary includes the misleading “扭转扇形” for twisted sectors and “引力下降部分” for gravitational descendants. The prose frequently follows English syntax too closely, including “并分解使得” followed by another “使得”, and the unfinished construction “它定义在模空间” followed by “它由公式”. Predominantly ASCII punctuation and inconsistent translated versus English terminology further reduce publication readiness.

The mathematical conditions are faithfully retained, including the pointwise nonvanishing requirement rendered as “处处非零” in the final construction. Terminology such as “本征” for proper, “虚拟闭链” for virtual cycle, and “稳定轨迹” for stable locus would benefit from editorial standardization. Phrases such as “单度数” in the degree-two rational-tail example and “它活在” are awkward, but all environments, formulas, labels, and citation keys are preserved.

This is particularly readable academic Chinese, with clear formulations such as “在虚意义下彼此双有理” and “概形结构依赖特征的选取”. However, the toy master-space condition at infinity introduces “对某个” index, changing the source condition stated for i = 1,2,3; the universal rational-tail inequality also attaches awkwardly to the following conditional. The earlier remark weakens “this is not possible” to “未必如此”. Every environment, formula, label, and citation is retained, although two added small-font groups alter the source formatting.

The final requirement that the pair of sections be nonvanishing is weakened to “不恒为零”, which allows simultaneous zeros and changes the master-space data. The final remark also translates non-separated as “高度不可分离”, confusing separatedness with inseparability. All mathematical environments and formulas are present and the LaTeX structure is preserved, but phrases such as “Hassett's 的” and the English toy-example headings leave the prose insufficiently edited.

This closely follows the mathematical argument, accurately preserving “次数严格小于” in the open-substack condition and “长度严格大于” in the final basepoint restriction. The phrase “不是真的（proper）” is distracting, and “不全为零” is less explicit about pointwise nonvanishing than the source requires. The retained English possessive after Hassett and occasional literal phrasing need editing, but every environment, equation, diagram, label, and citation key is preserved.

This is a consistently faithful and readable rendering, including “后者光滑” to clarify the ambient stable-map space and “处处不为零” for the final pair of sections. “一般满射” is less precise than saying generically surjective, while “虚拟闭链” and the repeated use of “稳定轨迹” merit terminology polishing. All definitions, examples, remarks, equations, diagrams, labels, and citation keys are retained without substantive mathematical LaTeX changes.

The general-target hypothesis “V is affine” becomes “V 是仿射空间”, incorrectly restricting the construction and conflicting with the subsequent singular-cone example. “完备障碍理论” mistranslates perfect obstruction theory, confusing the technical perfectness condition with completeness. The prose is generally readable, although “前稳定” and “一般满射” are less satisfactory choices here. All environments and formulas remain present, with harmless punctuation changes and translation of the etale arrow text rather than exact LaTeX preservation.

The argument and all environments, display equations, diagrams, labels, and citation keys are retained. However, “不全为零” leaves the final pointwise nonvanishing condition less explicit, and the literal phrase “存在多于一个带长度…基点的次数…” remains grammatically incomplete. Repeated “有理尾巴”, “磨光参数空间”, and densely mixed ASCII and Chinese punctuation make the prose less polished than the stronger versions.

The mathematical hypotheses, compact-type conditions, unit axioms, and quintic bound are faithfully retained, together with every environment and both figures. Terminology is less polished in expressions such as “外围”, “独点集”, and especially “单位扇形” for the unit sector. The definition of punctured legs leaves its English predicate untranslated, and phrases such as “由……一致有界” read mechanically, but the mathematical LaTeX and reference keys are preserved.

This is a clear, economical translation with appropriate terms such as “固有 DM 叠”, “虚圈”, and “单位扇区”; all environments, figures, equations, and reference keys are retained. The final corollary has an ungrammatical opening, “当……时”, applied to the pair (X,V), instead of saying that the conjecture holds for that pair. The wording “固有且满” is less precise than explicitly saying surjective, and the file adds an unsolicited page-layout command, although the formulas themselves remain intact.

The substantive definitions and theorem hypotheses are preserved, including the ambient variety’s lack of odd cohomology and the exceptions in the genus-one proposition. Several sentences are conspicuously literal, including “它不是真的” for nonproperness and “一个带有无标记点……的图” for a diagram with an unmarked curve. The punctured-leg predicate remains in English, but no environments or figures are missing and the mathematical formulas and reference keys are intact.

All environments, figures, formulas, and reference keys are preserved, and “且……无奇上同调” explicitly attaches the hypothesis to X correctly. Terms such as “约化虚类” and “单位扇区” work well, while “它不是真的” is an awkward way to express nonproperness even though 真 is a recognized technical rendering of proper. The fibered-category sentence grammatically attaches being fibered over LogSch to the maps rather than cleanly to their category, and the punctured-leg predicate is left in English.

The translation is consistently readable and preserves the theorem hypotheses, quantifiers, compact-type conditions, and all four unit-axiom statements. Expressions such as “它是……上的纤维范畴” and “上述猜想对……成立蕴含……” convey the categorical setup and final implication more clearly than most alternatives. “外围空间” is somewhat awkward and “三维流形” is less algebraically specific than threefold, but every environment and figure is present and the mathematical LaTeX and reference keys are preserved.

All environments, figures, formulas, reference keys, and the main numerical conclusions are retained. However, proper is systematically mistranslated as “专有”, producing statements such as “专有 DM 叠” and “专有临界轨迹” that fail to communicate the required geometric property. “前稳定性” is a less conventional choice than 预稳定性, and “锥流形间隙条件” is a poor rendering of the conifold gap condition; numerous English glosses also make the prose heavier.

The main decomposition theorem incorrectly describes Z as “一个无奇数上同调的 Calabi-Yau 三维超曲面”, moving the no-odd-cohomology hypothesis from the ambient Fano fourfold to the hypersurface. “在余维数 1 处光滑” and “在期望余维数处光滑” also blur the source’s separate requirements of smoothness and specified codimension. Terms such as “超级势” and “虚循环” are less standard here, and ASCII punctuation makes the Chinese presentation less polished, although every environment, figure, formula, and reference key is retained.

The mathematical exposition is largely faithful, but “在一般情形仍是公开的” mistranslates the assertion that the conjectures remain open as a statement about publicity. The footnote’s “彼此独立的陈述” also overstates the source’s weaker distinction between separate statements, and “稳定商墙交叉” is a literal rendering. All paragraphs, environments, formulas, figures, labels, and citation keys are retained.

This is generally concise and readable, with effective choices such as “全纯不确定项” and “稳定商过墙”. However, “为辛变换” incorrectly calls the symplectic space a transformation, and “放在满足…的结点处的类” makes the cotangent-class decoration sound like a condition on the node. Nothing substantive is omitted; the Yukawa display and generator display are reformatted, including an added gathered environment, while mathematical content and reference keys remain intact.

The claims, hypotheses, formal/GW distinction, and boundary-condition qualifications are preserved, with all environments and mathematical material present. “稳定相展开” and “稳定相渐近” are incorrect terminology for stationary phase, while phrases such as “万有领头项”, “组装二分其余图”, and “右端的两个对应” need editorial repair. The footnote’s “彼此独立的陈述” is stronger than merely saying the conjectures are separate statements; formulas and reference keys are otherwise exceptionally well preserved.

This preserves the mathematical argument and all environments, including the two conjectures and the subsequent-announcement footnote. Terminology needs harmonization: stationary phase becomes “稳定相”, normalization alternates among “正规化” and “规范化”, and the conifold gap changes from “锥点缝隙” to “conifold 间隙”. The hybrid “格罗莫夫--Witten” and the footnote’s stronger “彼此独立的命题” also need correction, although formulas, diagrams, and reference keys are retained.

This is the strongest overall: it clearly preserves the distinctions between formal and GW potentials, pole bounds and gap conditions, and assembled contributions and individual correlators. “用驻相法展开” and “一般情形下仍未解决” accurately handle passages that cause problems elsewhere, and the footnote correctly calls the formal conjectures “另外的命题”. “多重覆叠变换” is an unusual choice for multicover transformation, and occasional wording such as “形式领头间隙” needs polishing; all substantive content, diagrams, formulas, labels, and citation keys are present.

The translation is complete and preserves the equations, diagrams, reference keys, and the distinction between conjectural gap statements and the proved pole bound. “原生不变量” and “全纯模糊性” are nonstandard choices for primary invariants and holomorphic ambiguity, while “公开问题” is an inappropriate rendering of an open problem. Translating the tropical level as “能级” adds an energy interpretation absent from the source, although the accompanying English gloss helps identify the intended concept.

All substantive material and mathematical displays are present, including both figures, the special-insertion conjecture, and the final footnote. However, orbifold is repeatedly rendered as “轨道点” or “轨道正则性”, the mod-5 residue pattern becomes “留数模式”, and rational descendant insertions become the malformed “理后代插入”. Together with “全纯含糊性” and “公开问题”, these choices make the prose less reliable and less idiomatic, despite faithful preservation of formulas and reference keys.

The mathematical argument and all hypotheses are largely faithful, but translating proper as “本征的” gives the wrong technical property in the definition of the invariants. Repeated “环 Calabi--Yau” and “环图” are poor choices for toric geometry, and “已解消的锥形点” obscures the resolved conifold as a space. All paragraphs, theorem-like environments, displayed formulas, labels, and reference keys are retained.

This is a concise, generally faithful translation, with clear formulations such as “只要分子关于 ... 的次数至多为” in the rationality argument and consistent use of “拓扑递推”. “缩放特征” is less precise than rescaling a character, “Lefschetz 膜” would benefit from the original term, and “首阶量子微分方程” is ambiguous for the leading-order equation. All mathematical displays and environments are present, with labels and citation keys unchanged.

The substantive claims, reconstruction argument, and final identification of the minimal models are faithfully retained. The wording “模空间 ... 不是真的” is awkward and poorly disambiguates the technical sense of proper, while repeated “配为” for pairing and “次数被 ... 所界” make the Chinese less natural. Leaving “Lefschetz thimble” in English is reasonable, and every displayed equation, environment, label, and reference key is preserved.

The translation preserves the hypotheses and mathematical reasoning, and “不是真（proper）的” explicitly identifies the properness condition. “Lefschetz 鞘” is an unusual rendering, “领头阶” is less polished than a standard leading-order expression, and “R-矩阵矩阵元” is redundant. All equations, environments, labels, and reference keys are retained, but an extra terminal \bigskip changes the source layout.

This is the strongest overall version: “不是紧合的” correctly conveys the properness issue, and “只需再求出 ... 常数项” and the final “并令” identifications read naturally and precisely. Terminology such as “双标度极限” and “幂等元基” is consistent; minor edits would improve “有趣的是点” and clarify that “首阶量子微分方程” means the leading-order equation. The entire source is represented, and displayed mathematics, environments, labels, and reference keys are unchanged.

The reasoning is otherwise faithful, and “主导阶量子微分方程” accurately conveys the leading-order equation. However, “模空间 ... 不是专有的” mistranslates proper, while “在一般意义下互不相同” is less precise than generically distinct. Numerous English glosses are helpful but make the prose heavier; all source content and mathematical displays are present, with environments and reference keys intact.

The major claims and limiting arguments are faithfully preserved, with appropriate terminology such as “不是固有的” and “虚基本类”. “扇形” is less standard than fan as 扇, “保持 Calabi-Yau 型” is less explicit than preserving the differential form, and “首阶量子微分方程” can be confused with a first-order equation. All paragraphs and environments are complete, and all mathematical displays, labels, and reference keys are preserved.

Accurately preserves the two-part structure of the opening parenthetical ('除我本人与郭帅的报告之外的所有报告; 其中部分图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的') and keeps 'log GLSM' intact. However, it uses half-width ASCII commas and semicolons (', ', '; ') throughout Chinese prose instead of full-width Chinese punctuation, and leaves a stray space in '温耀雄 指出'.

Unpacks the awkward English parenthetical into a clear, unambiguous sentence ('除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告外，笔记均为现场用 TeX 记录；部分插图后来使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入'), preserving the exact logical scope of 'besides my own and those of Shuai Guo'. Reads very naturally in academic Chinese, with only a minor omission of the emphatic 'did' in '我曾让 Claude 阅读其他所有笔记'.

Fluent and well-formatted academic Chinese with clean LaTeX ('\TeX{} 笔记'). Its main flaw is compressing the opening parenthetical into '（除我本人以及郭帅的讲座外，部分插图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的）', which makes the exception clause appear to modify figure insertion rather than live-TeXing.

Polished and natural phrasing ('现场 TeX 速记稿', '在此一并致歉', '文风不一致'). Like C, however, its rendering of the parenthetical ('除我本人以及郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是事后使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入的') attaches the exception clause to figure insertion instead of live-TeXing.

Suffers from the same parenthetical scope shift as C and D ('除我自己和郭帅的报告外，部分图片是后来用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补上的'), and adopts a noticeably colloquial register ('都是用中文讲的', '补上的'). It also shifts the adjective '\textbf{experimental}' into an adverbial phrase ('\textbf{试验性}地由 AI 生成的转写稿').

Nicely resolves the opening parenthetical by adding '均为现场录入' ('除我本人及郭帅的课程外均为现场录入，部分配图后来使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入'). However, it mistranslates 'all of my other notes' as '我以往所有的笔记' ('past notes'), alternates inconsistently between '课程' and '报告', and renders 'experimental AI-generated transcriptions' rather stiffly as '由 AI 对其幻灯片进行转录的\textbf{实验性}产物'.

Exhibits the same parenthetical ambiguity ('除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是在会后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补充插入的') and over-translates 'later' as '在会后'. The prose mixes colloquialisms ('都是用中文讲的') with unidiomatic choices ('两次讲演'), turns '\textbf{实验性}地' into an adverb, and introduces an extra space in '感谢 周祐正'.

While mathematically faithful, A consistently translates 'stack' as '栈' ('商栈', '代数栈', 'Deligne–Mumford 栈') instead of the standard algebraic geometry term '叠', and renders vector bundle degree as '度' ('秩 r、度 d') rather than '次数'. It also uses nonstandard terms such as '本征的' for 'proper' ('分离代数栈的稳定化子群是本征的') and '细模'/'粗模'/'好模' (omitting '空间') in Table 1. Additionally, four English '\text{...}' strings inside displayed equations (such as '\text{ is a vector bundle on }' and '\text{isomorphism classes in }') are left untranslated.

B is complete and uses solid terminology ('商叠', '良模空间', '万有族'), but suffers from contorted phrasing whenever it tries to preserve the original position of math expressions. For example, it writes 'E \text{ 是如下空间上的向量丛：} C\times T', '\pi_0(\mf{X}(K))=\ab\{\text{其中的同构类：}\mf{X}(K)\}', and '若向量丛 E 对每个非零真饱和子层满足 \[ \mu(F)\leq\mu(E) \] 上述不等式（其中子层记为 F\subset E）'. In the GIT example, it also translates 'for some m \gg 0' redundantly as '对某个充分大的整数，定义线丛 ... 其中 m \gg 0'.

C leaves all four '\text{...}' strings inside equations as well as three definition titles ('[informal]', '[Slope stability]', '[S-equivalence]') and inline terms like 'Noetherian' and '\'etale' untranslated in English. In the virtual non-abelian localization theorem, it mistranslates homological 'acyclic' as '无环的' ('除有限多个 \alpha 外都是无环的', a graph-theoretic term) instead of '零调的'. Other flaws include '一族族的同构类的集合' in Subsection 1.1, translating 'line bundles' as '可逆层' in one passage, and writing '细模'/'粗模'/'良模' in Table 1.

D is mathematically accurate and uses mostly standard terminology ('商叠', '精细模空间', '零调的'), though it translates 'proper'/'nonproper' for the stabilizer group \G_m as '真（proper）的'/'非真的标量稳定化子' and 'pushforward functor' as '推出函子'. Like A and C, it leaves '\text{ is a vector bundle on }', '\text{isomorphism classes in }', '\text{for }', and '\begin{defn}[informal]' untranslated in English. Its prose frequently relies on awkward post-posed clauses or parentheticals, such as '固定一个丰富线丛 \mc{O}(1)，定义在 C 上' and '及滤过 f（B(p) 的滤过），若 \mu(f) > 0，则存在另一个滤过 f''（同为 B(p) 的滤过）'.

E is complete, accurate, and reads smoothly in idiomatic academic Chinese, properly translating all '\text{...}' strings inside equations (e.g., '\ab\{\mf{X}(K)\text{ 中的同构类}\}'). Its main terminology quirk is translating 'proper'/'nonproper' for algebraic stabilizer groups as '紧合的'/'非紧合的' ('分离代数叠的稳定子群是紧合的，而\G_m不是紧合的'). On the LaTeX side, it places raw Unicode 'Θ' in text mode in three section headings ('\section{Θ-分层（温耀雄、王彬）}%'), which is inconsistent with '\(\Theta\)' in the body and can fail in CJK fonts lacking Greek glyphs.

F is the strongest translation of this unit: complete, accurate, and written in natural, idiomatic Chinese mathematical prose. It thoughtfully adapts math-embedded text to Chinese grammar—for instance, reordering the condition in Example 1 to '&\text{对每个几何点 } \bar t\to T\text{，有 }\operatorname{rk}(E_{\bar t})=r,\quad \deg(E_{\bar t})=d'—and renders 'proper' for stabilizer groups clearly as '完备（proper）的'. The only minor terminology quibble is translating 'perfect complex' as '完备复形（perfect complex）' rather than the more standard '完美复形', though the parenthetical English prevents ambiguity.

G is complete, generally fluent, and uses standard terminology ('商叠', '良模空间', '非阿贝尔局部化', '完美复形'). However, in three section and subsection headings it changes capital 'Theta' to lowercase '$\theta$' ('\section{\texorpdfstring{$\theta$-分层}{Theta-stratifications}（温耀雄、王彬）}%'), which is mathematically inaccurate for Halpern-Leistner's \Theta = [\A^1/\G_m] and contradicts '\(\Theta\)-分层' in its own body text. It also contains a typo in Subsection 1.2 ('X 是一个带有所左 G-作用的概形') and leaves ASCII TeX quotes around Chinese phrases ('``典范过滤''''').

Translation A is mathematically faithful and complete, but uses non-standard algebraic geometry terminology in several key places: it translates 'stack' as '栈' ('对数结构之栈', '代数栈') instead of '叠', 'site' as '站点' ('小平展站点') instead of '景', and 'moduli' bare as '模' ('对数曲线的模'). Additionally, it leaves English '\text{...}' phrases inside displayed equations untranslated (e.g., '\text{ if there exists } s \in P \text{ such that }' and '\text{ is invertible outside }').

Translation B is accurate, complete, and reads naturally in most sections, using standard terms like '对数结构叠' and '小 étale 景'. However, it translates 'associated log structure' as '伴随对数结构' (confusing 'associated' with 'adjoint', whereas '相伴' is standard) and renders 'chart' simply as '图' ('以局部图表述的对数光滑性判据'), which collides with 'diagram' and 'graph'. In Subsection 1.3, it also awkwardly translates 'f \text{ is invertible outside } D' as 'f \text{ 在如下集合外可逆：} D' to avoid splitting the '\text' macro.

Translation C has several notable terminology and accuracy lapses: in Subsection 1.8 it bizarrely translates 'integral map' as '对数积（integral）映射' despite using '整的' earlier, and in Subsections 1.9–1.10 it mistranslates sheaf-theoretic 'generalization maps' as '广义化映射'. It also inconsistently leaves 'fine' untranslated in Subsection 1.12 ('fine 对数概形', 'fine 子幺半群'), translates 'small étale site' as '小 \'etale 拓扑', and leaves English '\text{...}' strings inside displayed equations untranslated.

Translation D suffers from a severe terminology error, repeatedly mistranslating 'integral' (for monoids, log schemes, and morphisms) as the nonsensical '对数积' ('称 P 是对数积（integral）的', '有限生成且对数积'). Furthermore, starting in Subsection 1.7 it abruptly stops translating core adjectives altogether, writing 'fine 的（甚至是 fine saturated 的）', 'integral 的', and 'saturated 的' in the middle of Chinese sentences. Like A and C, it also leaves English '\text{...}' strings inside displayed equations untranslated.

Translation E is outstanding and publication-ready, with accurate mathematical meaning, natural academic Chinese prose, and fully translated '\text{...}' expressions in math mode. Its terminology is standard and 100% consistent throughout, including '小平展景' for small étale site, '相伴对数结构' for associated log structure, '对数结构的叠' for stack of log structures, and '卡' for chart (cleanly avoiding collision with '交换图' for commutative diagram).

Translation F is complete and generally readable, but contains a stray Japanese hiragana character 'の' in Subsection 1.3 ('它是如下图表の上极限（colimit）：'). It also inserts unprompted editorial additions not in the English source, such as translating 'the specialization map' in Subsection 1.9 as '特化映射（或泛化映射）' and adding '（integral，或满足消去律的）' in Subsection 1.2. Some terminology choices are non-standard for algebraic geometry, notably '泛型点' (a computer science term) for 'generic point' and '前对数结构'/'前稳定曲线' instead of '预对数结构'/'预稳定曲线'.

Translation G commits a serious mathematical mistranslation throughout the entire unit by rendering 'fine' as '有限的' ('finite'), producing false mathematical statements such as '有限幺半群', '有限对数概形', and '包含 \N \oplus \N 的有限子幺半群' (a submonoid containing \N \oplus \N cannot be finite). In Theorem 3.5(1), it garbles the grammar so that the orders of the groups are claimed to be finite groups ('的核与余核的挠部分的阶是在 X 上可逆的有限群'). It also uses non-standard terms such as '法相交除子' for normal crossings divisor and leaves 'site' untranslated in '小 \'etale site'.

Mathematically attentive in places (correctly identifying that X is the toric variety in '对我们而言，\(X\) 将是环簇'), but mistranslates 'proper' for the moduli space of stable maps as '本征的' (confusing algebraic-geometric properness with eigenvalues). It also translates algebraic 'stack' as '栈' ('Deligne--Mumford 栈', '带正确的栈结构') instead of the standard '叠', and mixes '镜面' ('计数镜面对称', '镜面定理', '镜面映射') with '镜像' ('镜像五次三维流形', '镜像族'). Several sentences wrapping display equations leave a period inside the equation before '给出。' or '的向量空间'.

The strongest translation of this unit: accurate, idiomatic, and well-structured around equations. It correctly renders subtle points such as '将把 I 函数视为环面簇 \(X\) 的某个镜像族上的积分' and 'MSP 团队', and uses standard terminology ('虚基本类', 'Deligne--Mumford 叠', '重言类', '三维簇'). Minor blemishes include translating 'Lefschetz thimble' as 'Lefschetz 膜' and 'r-spin curves' as 'r-旋曲线', mixing '拉格朗日锥' with 'Lagrange 乘子', and translating '\text{even}/\text{odd}' inside math subscripts as '\delta_{k, \text{偶数}}'.

Suffers from stiff word-for-word translationese and several accuracy and terminology lapses. It mistranslates 'up to various prefactors' as '在各种前因子范围内', renders 'variation of Hodge structure' as '霍奇结构的变化', and has a typo '这是因为我展开' for 'because we expand'. It also leaves English word order intact in clauses like '对 \(\alpha_i \in H^*(X)\)。' and '若 \(V = H^*(X)\) 对 Calabi-Yau 三维簇 \(X\)', and switches mid-document from 'Gromov-Witten 理论' and 'Frobenius 流形' to '格罗莫夫-威滕理论' and '弗罗贝尼乌斯流形'.

Generally solid on core algebraic geometry terms (such as '虚基本类', '真（proper）的', 'Deligne–Mumford 叠', and '重言类'), but commits an accuracy error by translating 'the MSP group has removed this restriction' as '但 MSP 群已经去除了这一限制' (treating the MSP research group as a mathematical group). It also introduces awkward redundancy in '这给出（分次）维数 $\chi(V)$，也就是 $V$ 的（分次）维数', and inconsistently mixes '欧拉向量场' with 'Euler 向量场' and '算符' with '算子'.

A fluent, natural, and mathematically faithful translation that handles equation punctuation and complex sentences smoothly (e.g. '这里我们只考虑环面簇的情形' and 'MSP 小组'). Its main weakness is terminology in the opening subsection, where it translates 'proper' as the non-standard '紧合的', uses '虚拟基本类' instead of '虚基本类', and refers to projective threefolds as '三维流形' rather than '三维簇'.

Very readable and accurate academic Chinese (correctly clarifying '（对我们来说，\(X\) 将是环面簇）' and 'MSP 团队'), with clean sentence structure around displayed equations. However, it mistranslates 'tautological class' and 'tautological relations' on the moduli space of curves as '典范类（tautological class）' and '典范关系（tautological relations）', confusing 'tautological' ('重言') with 'canonical' ('典范').

Mostly accurate with standard terminology ('虚基本类', 'Deligne-Mumford 叠', '重言类', 'r-自旋曲线'), though it attaches 'which for us will be a toric variety' to the mirror family ('对我们而言该镜像族是一个环簇') and translates 'quintic threefold' as '五次超曲面'. Fluency is hurt by 14 instances where a display equation retains a final period right before a continuation such as '给出。', '定义。', or '的无穷维向量空间 $V\ls{z^{-1}}$'.

A very accurate and complete translation with clean LaTeX formatting and helpful distinction between a sheaf ("层") and a stratum ("层片"). Its main terminology quirk is translating "proper map/morphism" as "本征映射/本征态射" (more common in differential geometry than algebraic geometry, where "真态射" or "固有态射" is standard), and line 57 translates "fibration in possibly singular varieties" slightly ambiguously as "可能奇异的簇之间的 C^\infty 纤维化". It also leaves "relevant" untranslated in the subscript "\bigoplus_{Y_{\lambda}\text{ relevant}}".

Uses good algebraic geometry terminology (such as "固有态射" for proper morphism and "保持典范类的奇点消解" for crepant resolution), but suffers from a major LaTeX structural error at lines 64–67 where the end of the sentence before a definition ("满足 Verdier 对偶性。") is accidentally placed inside the next "\begin{defn}" environment. It also drops "unfortunately" in the final example ("但所有幂零轨道都相关") and truncates "a summand of dimension 4" to "\ab(\text{维数为 } 4)", losing the noun "summand".

Complete and generally accurate, using standard terms such as "真映射" (proper map) and "W-主齐性空间" (W-torsor). However, line 57 translates "a C^\infty fibration in possibly singular varieties" literally as "（可能奇异的）簇中的 C^\infty 纤维化", which obscures that the varieties are the fibers, and it leaves two inline math text phrases untranslated in English ("Y_{\lambda}\text{ relevant}" and "\ab(\text{a summand of dimension } 4)"). Some phrasing is also slightly stiff, such as "对所有层 Y_{\lambda} 变化".

A fluent and faithful translation with strong terminology choices ("真态射", "泛有限", "可构造层", "反常层"). Minor blemishes include leaving "Y_{\lambda}\text{ relevant}" and "\ab(\text{a summand of dimension } 4)" in English inside display math, translating "W-torsor" as the slightly truncated "W-扭", and rendering "fibration in possibly singular varieties" as "（可能奇异的）簇之间的 C^\infty 纤维化".

Reads naturally and accurately captures "fibration in possibly singular varieties" as "纤维为（可能奇异的）簇的 C^\infty 纤维化", while translating all math-mode text cleanly. However, it mistranslates "W-torsor" as "W-旋子" (confusing torsor/扭子 with spinor/旋量) and uses the non-standard term "紧合映射" for "proper map" throughout. It also omits spaces around inline math and misses a space in "奇点的crepant 消解".

The most natural and polished Chinese prose among all seven translations, smoothly supplying "设 X 为一个空间" in Question 1 and translating all inline math text ("Y_{\lambda}\text{ 相关}", "\ab(\text{一个 } 4 \text{ 维直和项})"). Its score is held back slightly by terminology: it translates "crepant resolution" as "同调平凡解消" (confusing crepant/保持典范类 with homologically trivial), uses "完备映射" (complete) for "proper map", and uses "Künneth" in Unicode rather than "K\"unneth".

Complete and accurately translates "fibration in possibly singular varieties" as "以可能奇异的簇为纤维的 C^\infty 纤维化", as well as all math-mode text. However, in Example 2 of semi-small maps it mistranslates "a crepant resolution f \colon \tilde{Y} \to Y of singularities" as "奇异的 crepant 解消", turning "of singularities" into an adjective meaning the resolution itself is singular. It also leaves theorem headers "[K\"unneth formula]" and "[Leray/Serre spectral sequence]" untranslated and mixes "relevant 分层" with "相关".

Complete and mathematically faithful overall, but suffers from non-standard algebraic geometry terminology: it consistently translates stack as '栈' ('Deligne–Mumford 栈', '惯性栈') instead of '叠', pushforward as '推出' ('沿本征态射的推出', which means pushout) instead of '推前/前推', and proper as '本征'. It also leaves English periods and commas inside displayed equations when the Chinese sentence continues on the next line (e.g., '[formula.] 上。它由公式 [formula,] 定义，其中').

A solid, complete translation with accurate mathematical terminology ('DM 叠', '惯性叠', '虚结构层', '推前', '分歧覆盖'). Its main flaws are three orphan full-width periods placed at the start of a new line immediately after displayed equations ('\[ ... \]\n。若 f 是完美态射'), a slightly awkward split in Section 3 ('回顾到目标空间的稳定映射模空间 ... 其中目标为 X'), and the unprompted addition of '{\small ...}' around two align* environments in Section 9.

Mathematically accurate and complete with mostly standard terminology ('真（proper）态射', '惯性叠', '引力后代'), though it is slightly inconsistent between 'Calabi--Yau 三维簇' and 'Calabi-Yau 三维流形'. Fluency is held back by stiff word-for-word English clause order around displayed equations—such as '并计算 [formula] 通过虚拟局部化。', '我们看到 [formula] 由 Serre 对偶。', and '计算关联函数 [formula] 通过展开 [formula]'—as well as trailing periods/commas left inside displays before Chinese continuations.

Complete and generally accurate, but marred by several incomplete sentences and punctuation defects. In Section 6 Definition 1, '环路空间 (\mc{K}, \Omega) 由 \[ ... \] 配上辛形式 \[ ... \]' is missing its closing verb ('组成'), Section 10 '其中我们应将 x = T_1 且 u(x) = ...' omits the verb after '将', and Section 8 translates 'Decompose the inertia' literally as '将惯性分解为' (omitting '叠'). It also has six orphan punctuation marks ('\n。' and '\n，') at the start of lines after displayed equations in Section 10 and uses straight ASCII quotes ('"计数"').

The strongest translation of this unit: complete, accurate, and written in natural, idiomatic academic Chinese. It uses consistent terminology ('DM 叠', '惯性叠', '虚拟结构层', '前推', '分歧覆叠') and carefully restructures sentences and display-math punctuation so that clauses like '并通过虚拟局部化计算' and '由 Serre 对偶可知' read smoothly in Chinese.

Although very fluent and well-punctuated around equations, this translation commits a serious terminology and accuracy error in Sections 2 and 3 by translating both 'proper' and 'perfect' as '完备' ('其中 K^0 指完备复形', '沿完备态射的前推', '如果 f 是完备态射（perfect morphism...）', and '带有完备障碍理论（perfect obstruction theory）的完备 DM 叠'). Conflating proper morphisms/stacks and perfect morphisms/complexes with '完备' (complete) distorts core algebraic geometry concepts.

This translation uses half-width ASCII commas, semicolons, colons, question marks, and parentheses throughout Chinese prose, and mistranslates 'gravitational descendants' as '引力下降部分' and 'twisted sectors' as '扭转扇形'. It also contains broken sentence structures around displayed equations in Section 9, such as splitting a prepositional phrase across a display ('从它在 \[ f_{q=\zeta} = ... \] 单位根 \zeta 处的 Laurent 展开中') and omitting predicates after displays ('它定义在模空间 \[ ... . \] 它由公式 \[ ... , \] 其中 N 表示').

Terminology is poor and non-standard throughout: it translates wall-crossing literally as “墙交叉”, stack as “栈” instead of “叠” (“本征 Deligne–Mumford 栈”, “开子栈”), degree as “度数” instead of “次数” (“有正度数”), and proper as “本征的”. In Subsection 3 it mistranslates “a single degree 2 rational tail” as “单度数 2 有理尾” (reading “single” as modifying “degree”), and in Subsection 1 it translates “This lives in” literally as “它活在 ... 中” while leaving “\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}” untranslated.

The prose is concise and readable, but in the second toy example of Subsection 4 it misattaches “for all rational tails C'” to the next clause (“并且对所有有理尾 \(C'\)，若 \(v = 0\)，则 \(x_4\) 与其他 \(x_i\) 不交”), leaving C' unbound in the preceding displayed inequality and changing the condition for v = 0. On the LaTeX side, it inserts “{\small ... }” wrappers around two displayed equations that are not in the source and places lone Chinese periods at the start of lines following “\]” (lines 208 and 274). It also translates “proper” as “固有” (“固有 DM 叠”) and “toy example” as “简化例子”.

Uses solid algebraic geometry terminology (“越墙”, “真 DM叠”, “挠子”, “特征标”), but leaves the optional environment headers “[Second toy example]” and “[Another toy example]” as well as “\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}” untranslated in English. In Subsection 4 it translates “where (v_1, v_2) is nonvanishing” inaccurately as “且 \((v_1, v_2)\) 不恒为零” (not identically zero, rather than nowhere vanishing) and writes “Hassett\textquotesingle s 的加权模空间” and “Hassett's 的加权带点曲线模空间” with double possessives. Several sentences retain awkward English word order, such as “于是我们可以计算 \[ \int_{\P^{n-1}} H^{n-1} = 1 \] 通过将计算转移到另一个不动点轨迹。”.

This translation has the most accurate and idiomatic algebraic geometry terminology in the set (“越墙”, “五次三维簇”, “带完美障碍理论的真 DM叠”, “特征标”, “虚圈”). Minor blemishes include leaving “\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}” in English, keeping “Hassett\textquotesingle s 加权模空间” on line 200, and placing a period at the beginning of the line after “\]” on lines 206 and 272. In Subsection 4 it renders the elliptical English phrase “more than one degree d_0 with a base point” literally as “存在多于一个次数 \(d_0\) 并带有长度 \(d_0\) 基点的情形” without supplying “尾”.

Very fluent and complete—translating all inline “\text{...}” blocks and environment headers, and accurately rendering “(v_1, v_2) 处处不为零” and “多于一个次数为 \(d_0\)、带有长度为 \(d_0\) 的基点的尾”—but marred by a clear terminology error in Subsection 3 where “a \(\C^{\times}\)-torsor” is translated as “一个 \(\C^{\times}\)-旋子” (spinor instead of torsor/挠子). It also prefers physics-flavored terminology such as “壁穿越” and “壁与腔”, and translates “quintic threefold” as “五次三维流形”.

Fluency and LaTeX formatting are excellent, but there are two substantive mathematical mistranslations: in Subsection 3, “where V is affine” (an affine variety/cone with lci singularities) is rendered as “其中 \(V\) 是仿射空间” (affine space), and in Subsection 4, “it will travel directly to itself along the \(\C^{\times}\)-action” is rendered as “它在 \(\C^{\times}\)-作用下保持不动” (stays fixed, whereas a general point has v \neq 0, \infty and moves between the two chambers). It also translates both “perfect” and “proper” as “完备” in “带有完备障碍理论的完备 DM 叠”, and adds an explanatory gloss “（即结点和标记点）” not in the source.

Uses half-width ASCII punctuation (commas, colons, semicolons, parentheses) directly between Chinese characters over 200 times (“为简单起见,设”, “其中 \(\pi\) 是泛曲线,\(f\) 是泛稳定映射”) and places lone periods “。” on new lines after “\end{align*}” and “\]” (lines 42, 206, 270, 272). In Subsection 2 it omits the curve symbol “\(C\)” from “consider a nodal curve \(C\) with a marking” (“考虑一条带有一个标记的节点曲线”), and in Subsection 1 it drops “threefold” by translating “quintic threefold” simply as “五次超曲面”. Terminology is also somewhat awkward, including “固有的” for proper, “虚循环” for virtual cycle, and “节点磨光参数” for node smoothing parameters.

Accurate and faithful to the mathematical claims, though it leaves the set-builder text inside one displayed equation untranslated ("is bounded and nontrivial for all"). Its main weakness is non-standard algebraic geometry terminology in Chinese, using "栈" for stack, "本征" for proper, and "环簇/环扇" for toric variety/toric fan. It also translates two optional citation arguments while leaving "\cite[Conjecture~1.6]{CJRtropical2025}" in English.

Concise and complete, but contains a notable translation error at the final corollary: "The above conjecture for (X, V) implies..." is rendered as the ungrammatical "当 (X, V) 时，上述猜想蕴含...". It also inserts an unauthorized layout command "\enlargethispage{3pt}" not in the source, and awkwardly translates the set-builder condition as "对所有如下元素均有界且非平凡：t \in Q_{\R}^{\vee}".

Uses standard algebraic geometry terminology consistently ("叠", "真", "虚闭链", "余截面局部化") and preserves all LaTeX macros and citation options faithfully.
