However, it leaves the English phrase "is bounded and nontrivial for all" untranslated inside the displayed formula for punctured legs, and occasionally exhibits stiff word-for-word phrasing such as "一个带有无标记点 C 的图" for "a diagram with C unmarked".

Very accurate and natural academic Chinese, properly clarifying "Let Z be a Calabi-Yau threefold hypersurface in a Fano fourfold X with no odd cohomology" as "设 Z 是 Fano 四维簇 X 中的 Calabi–Yau 三维超曲面，且 X 无奇上同调". Terminology is standard and consistent throughout ("叠", "真", "虚类"), with helpful English glosses on first occurrence. Its only minor lapse is leaving "is bounded and nontrivial for all" untranslated inside the displayed equation for \L^{\circ}.

Fluent, natural Chinese prose that translates all text including the set-builder condition inside the displayed formula for \L^{\circ}. Terminology is mostly strong ("叠", "丰沛", "虚拟闭链"), though "紧合" for proper is less standard in algebraic geometry than "真" or "固有", and "threefold/fourfold" is rendered as "三维流形/四维流形" rather than "簇". It also translates the optional arguments of \cite commands into Chinese (e.g. "\cite[定理~1.7]{CJRtropical2025}").

Complete, accurate, and preserves all LaTeX environments, macros, and citation options intact, including a clean translation of the text inside the displayed formula for \L^{\circ} ("对所有 t \in Q_{\R}^{\vee}，\Sigma(f)_t(h) 是有界且非平凡的"). The prose is clear and well-structured, though some terminology choices—such as "专有" for proper, "前稳定性" for pre-stability, and "充裕" for ample—are slightly less idiomatic than "真/固有", "预稳定性", and "丰沛/丰富".

Suffers from a serious mathematical scope mistranslation in the main theorem, rendering "a Calabi-Yau threefold hypersurface in a Fano fourfold X with no odd cohomology" as "Fano 四维流形 X 中一个无奇数上同调的 Calabi-Yau 三维超曲面" (attributing no odd cohomology to Z instead of X, even though a CY3 hypersurface always has b_3 > 0). In addition, it uses half-width ASCII punctuation (",", ":", ";", "?") throughout the Chinese prose and places Chinese punctuation at the beginning of lines right after displayed equations (e.g. "。现在,一个 R-映射...").

Complete and well-formatted LaTeX, but contains a garbled grammatical inversion in Subsection 8.5 ("以前者由后者表出" for "expresses the former in terms of the latter") and translates "stationary phase asymptotics" as "稳相近似" (approximation). Terminology for mirror symmetry is inconsistent across paragraphs, mixing "镜流形", "镜面定理", "镜面对称", and "镜像族", and "mod 5 charge rule" is rendered as "模 5 的电荷规则" (electric charge). A few phrases are also slightly awkward, such as "只有 \(n_{g,\beta}\) 被期望是整的".

Contains two notable mathematical mistranslations: in Subsection 8.3, "Let \(\mc{H} = \mc{H}^- \oplus \mc{H}^+ \subset \mc{H}_{\infty}\) be symplectic" is rendered as "设 ... 为辛变换" (calling the symplectic vector space a symplectic transformation), and in Subsection 8.6, "placed at a node with \(\bar{\psi}_1^p \bar{\psi}_2^q\)" becomes "放在满足 \(\bar{\psi}_1^p \bar{\psi}_2^q\) 的结点处的类". In LaTeX, it unnecessarily alters an align* layout and wraps an equation in gathered, and omits a space in "\text{对} i \leq ..." so that "对i" collides. The prose frequently drops subjects ("考虑... 问其中...", "使用五次三维簇..."), giving it a clipped, telegraphic feel.

Suffers from a sharp terminology break starting in Subsection 8.8: after using "五次三维簇 Gromov-Witten 理论", "二部图", and "腿" in Subsections 8.1–8.7, it abruptly switches to "五次格罗莫夫–威滕理论", "二分图", and "无脚" (for "no legs"), and even mixes "剩余图" and "其余图" in adjacent sentences. In LaTeX, all five English "\text{...}" macros inside display equations ("\text{ effective}", "\text{ bipartite}", "\text{ exists}", "\text{for }") are left untranslated. Several expressions are overly literal or missing words, such as "每一列最终都会消失" for "every column eventually vanishes" and "右端的两个对应" (omitting "项").

Exhibits severe internal terminology inconsistency between the first and second halves of the unit, switching from "正规化势" to "规范化势", "t-扭" to "t-扭曲", "关联函数" to "关联子", and "锥点" to "conifold（锥奇点）", and even producing the half-Chinese, half-English hybrid "五次格罗莫夫--Witten 理论" in the final footnote. It also mistranslates "Leading BPS invariants" in Table 1 as "主要 BPS 不变量" and leaves all five "\text{...}" macros inside display math untranslated in English. Sentence flow is repeatedly broken around display equations, leaving isolated words like "开始。", "零化。", and "给出。" on their own lines.

The strongest translation of this unit: mathematically accurate, complete, and written in natural, idiomatic Chinese academic prose (e.g., "切开一条求过导的边之后，得到的是 \(\mc{R}\) 中更低亏格的关联函数，论证就此封闭"). Terminology is consistent and standard throughout ("五次三维流形", "虚拟闭链", "轨形点", "锥形奇点", "有理后代插入"), and all LaTeX macros and "\text{...}" expressions inside display math are properly handled. Only a negligible variation between "\text{ 二部图}" and "\text{ 二部}" in summation subscripts prevents a perfect terminology score.

A fluent, complete, and well-formatted translation that preserves all LaTeX structures and translates all inline "\text{...}" macros cleanly. Its main flaw is in Remark 8.8, where "a level of a bipartite tropical curve" is mistranslated as "二分热带曲线的一个能级（level）" (using the quantum-mechanical term "能级" for energy level instead of "层" or "层级"). A few other terminology choices are slightly non-standard or mixed, such as "原生不变量（primary invariants）", "锥流形点", and shifting from "零亏格" in Subsections 8.1–8.2 to "亏格二" later.

Well-formatted and fluent overall, but marred by three clear mathematical terminology errors: it consistently mistranslates "orbifold point" as "轨道点" (orbit point) instead of "轨形点", mistranslates "one residue pattern" in the mod 5 charge rule (Subsection 8.7) as "一种留数模式" (analytic residue rather than modular residue "剩余/余数"), and drops "有" from "有理后代插入" twice in Subsection 8.10 to produce the ungrammatical "带理后代插入" and "完整的理后代插入". All LaTeX environments and math formulas are otherwise cleanly preserved.

Complete and structurally clean, but marred by recurring algebraic geometry terminology errors. In particular, it translates 'toric' as '环' ('环 Calabi--Yau 三维簇') and 'toric graph' as '环图' (which means cycle/ring graph rather than '环面图'), renders 'not proper' for the moduli space as '不是本征的' instead of '不是真的' or '不是固有的', and translates 'resolved conifold' as '已解消的锥形点'. It also uses '镜面对称'/'镜面曲线' rather than the standard '镜像对称'/'镜像曲线', and includes a minor LaTeX spacing blemish '，~\Cref{conj:cgmps}' on line 51.

Concise and complete, but several terminology choices are non-standard: 'ansatz' is rendered as '表达式猜想' ('结构表达式猜想' for 'structural ansatz'), 'double-scaling limit' as '双重缩放极限', 'total space' as '总空间', and 'Lefschetz thimbles' as 'Lefschetz 膜'. On line 34, '其中变量 \(w\) 通过 \(w = 1-q\)、\(w_c = 1 - \frac{1}{p^2}\) 与 Kähler 参数 \(q\) 联系' inaccurately groups the constant $w_c$ as part of the relation between $w$ and $q$, and line 34 leaves '适用于 \(g \geq 2\)。' dangling awkwardly after a displayed equation. Line 29 also contains a stray Windows CRLF line ending.

A solid translation with strong mathematical terminology ('环面 Calabi-Yau 三维簇', '不是真的', '拟设', '态空间') and accurate restoration of Chinese mathematicians' names ('周坚以及陈琳–李逸–刘克峰', '方博汉–刘秋菊–宗正宇'). However, it repeatedly drops a character when translating 'pairing', writing '配为' instead of '配对为' on lines 107 and 162, and translates 'the invariants $\omega_{g,n}$' on line 156 as '所产生的数量 \(\omega_{g,n}\)'. Minor formatting issues include a stray space in '与许景毅和 张庆生的合作工作' (line 4) and starting a paragraph with '~\Cref' (line 56).

Mathematically accurate and generally fluent, with good terminology ('环面 Calabi-Yau 三维簇', '真（proper）的', '拟设', '辛对换'), though transliterating 'Gromov-Witten' as '格罗莫夫–威滕' throughout the body (while keeping 'GW' in the title and other names like 'Calabi-Yau' in Latin script) and rendering 'Lefschetz thimbles' as 'Lefschetz 鞘' are unusual. Its main weaknesses are in LaTeX formatting: line 29 places a Chinese comma immediately after closing display math ('\]，'), which causes a lone comma to typeset at the start of the next line, and line 262 appends an extraneous '\bigskip' not present in the source.

The strongest translation of this unit: mathematically faithful, complete, and written in natural, idiomatic academic Chinese. It uses accurate terminology throughout ('全空间', '拟设', '双标度极限', '带标架的 R 矩阵', '态空间', '幂等元基', '拓扑递归') and restructures multi-clause sentences around displayed equations smoothly (e.g., '普通锥形奇点处亏格\(g\)的首项极点阶数为\(2g-2\)；与之不同，这一退化处的极点阶数至多为\(5g-5\)'). All LaTeX environments, macros, labels, and references are preserved cleanly without formatting defects.

Complete and mostly readable, with helpful parenthetical English glosses on first occurrence, but it commits a severe terminology error on line 92 by translating 'the moduli space $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{g,0}(X_p,d)$ is not proper' as '模空间 \(\Mbar_{g,0}(X_p,d)\) 不是专有的' (confusing algebro-geometric properness with 'proprietary/exclusive'). Elsewhere it uses '拓扑递推' instead of '拓扑递归' and '状态空间' instead of '态空间', and adds a parenthetical inline math gloss '（framed \(R\)-matrix）' on line 56.

A very accurate and fluent translation that handles sentences spanning displayed equations naturally (e.g., '我们通过 ... 定义关联函数') and uses standard terminology ('固有的', '虚基本类', '标架', '双标度极限', '拓扑递归与重塑猜想'). It loses points on LaTeX hygiene for leaving the second argument of '\texorpdfstring' untranslated in English on line 1 ('\texorpdfstring{局部 \(\P^1\) 的高亏格 GW 理论的结构}{Structure of higher-genus GW theory of local P1}') and inserting a raw Unicode Greek character 'Γ' in text mode on line 190 ('从而得到 Γ 函数的乘积').

Faithful and complete, preserving the source's parenthetical scope in "除我本人与郭帅的报告之外的所有报告; 其中部分图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的" and correctly rendering "AI 根据其幻灯片生成的实验性转写". Uses the \TeX macro, but punctuates with half-width commas throughout ("请注意, 所有报告..."), which reads as a global style pass rather than finished Chinese typography, and there is a stray space in "温耀雄 指出". The singular "本笔记" for "These are...notes" is a small flattening of the plural.

Accurate and very readable; it splits the opening into "这些笔记记录了...暑期学校" plus "除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告外，笔记均为现场用 TeX 记录", so the live-TeXed attribution survives, and "部分插图后来使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入" is right. Minor losses: the concessive "While I did give Claude access" becomes a flat semicolon clause ("我曾让 Claude 阅读其他所有笔记以了解我的写作风格"), and it writes plain "TeX" rather than \TeX. Full-width punctuation is consistent.

The closest mirror of the source, keeping clause order and the parenthetical exactly: "这些是...对数 GLSM 暑期学校讲座的现场 \TeX{} 笔记（除我本人以及郭帅的讲座外，部分插图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的）". Terminology is consistent (讲座 throughout, "实验性 AI 转录稿", "对数 GLSM"), punctuation is clean full-width, and \TeX{} is used correctly. No omissions or additions of substance.

Accurate, complete and idiomatic, e.g. "为现场 TeX 速记稿" and "在此一并致歉", with all clauses intact including "若有任何翻译错误，以及我讲座中的任何错误". Minor points: "速记稿" leans toward shorthand rather than live-TeXing, and it writes plain "TeX" instead of the \TeX macro; the 报告/讲座 alternation matches the English talks/lectures distinction, so it is defensible.

Content is faithful and complete, but "试验性" replaces the expected "实验性" for \textbf{experimental}, and "根据他的幻灯片试验性地由 AI 生成的转写稿" has awkward adverb placement. Colloquial phrasing such as "所有报告都是用中文讲的" and "其中的翻译错误" lowers the academic register; plain "TeX" rather than \TeX.

Fluent and otherwise complete, but it shifts meaning: "errors in my lectures" becomes "我本人讲义中的疏漏" (疏漏 = oversights, 讲义 = handout), 课程 is used for "talks" while "除我的课程外，其余所有报告均以中文讲授" mixes terms in one breath, and "all of my other notes" loses "other" as "我以往所有的笔记". "实验性产物" also drops the noun "transcriptions" (转录稿). LaTeX and punctuation are faultless and \TeX{} is used correctly.

Faithful and complete, with a nice rendering of "While I did" as "虽然我确实让 Claude 阅读过" and "部分插图是在会后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补充插入的". Downside is the awkward "实验性地由 AI 生成的转录" (parallel to E) and a stray space in "感谢 周祐正"; it writes plain "TeX" rather than \TeX.

Faithful and complete: display and inline math match the English source exactly, and the prose is natural and accurate. However several pieces inside math mode were left in English, e.g. \(E \text{ is a vector bundle on } C\times T\) and \(\text{isomorphism classes in }\mf{X}(K)\), plus \(\text{for }\alpha\leq\beta\), which would look unpolished in a published Chinese PDF. Terminology is otherwise strong (丰沛, 前推, 万有族, 平展, 笛卡儿图, 定理~5.1), though it uses 栈 for 'stack' throughout and the literal 局部有限展示 for 'locally of finite presentation' (usual: 局部有限表现).

The strongest overall: all English text embedded in math was translated (e.g. '对每个几何点 \(\bar t\to T\)', '当\(\alpha\leq\beta\)'), and the Chinese reads naturally throughout. Terminology is standard and consistent (叠, 良模空间, 固有, 丰沛, 万有族, 推前). Minor blemishes: 'Cartesian 图表' and 'étale 邻域' are left in English, the tabular preamble gained @{} not present in the source, and the slope-stability sentence is clunky ('对每个非零真饱和子层满足 … 上述不等式（其中子层记为 \(F\subset E\)）').

Complete and essentially accurate, but visibly less polished than the leaders: the environment titles '[informal]', '[Slope stability]', '[S-equivalence]' and 'Theorem~5.1' are left in English, as are the math-mode phrases 'is a vector bundle on' and 'isomorphism classes in'. There are also small slips such as '一族族' for 'families' and '等价地等价于', and it mixes Chinese with English in '真（proper）的'. Terminology is otherwise consistent (叠, 泛族, 前推), though it uses the older 丰富 for 'ample'.

Fluent and accurate, with careful renderings such as '点 \(x_0=\lim_{t\to 0}\lambda(t)x\) 有定义' that capture the source's 'we can define the point'. Terminology is good (精细模空间, 好模空间, 平展, 笛卡儿图, 诺特, 泛族), though it uses the older 丰富 for 'ample' and 推出函子 for pushforward. It shares A's defect of leaving 'is a vector bundle on', 'isomorphism classes in' and 'for' inside math, and it is heavy with parenthetical English glosses (（global quotient）,（atlas）,（proper）,（good quotient）,（contraction）); it also adds 线丛 in '行列式线丛与虚秩'.

Complete and fluent, with all English text inside math translated and good standard terminology (叠, 紧合 for 'proper', 丰沛, 万有族, 前推). It preserves the table and all environments exactly as in the source. Minor issues: 'Cartesian 图表', 'DVR R', 'etale' and qcqs are left untranslated, it alternates between 层 (stratum) and 分层片, and it uses 滤链 where 滤过 is more common. The small addition '若不等式总是严格的' is harmless.

Complete and faithful, and unlike A/C/D it translates all English text inside math mode. Its weakness is terminology: 'perfect complex' is rendered 完备复形 (usual: 完美复形) while 'proper' is also rendered 完备, so one word covers two distinct notions ('分离代数叠的稳定子群是完备（proper）的'), and 'scalar' becomes the nonstandard 纯量. It also adds many parenthetical English glosses (（stack）,（groupoid）,（inertia）,（pseudofunctor）,（descent）,（quasi-smooth）, …) and uses unusual 容有 for 'admits', which makes the style heavy.

Accurate and complete, and it translates the text inside math. But it uses 过滤 for 'filtration' throughout (standard: 滤过/滤链), leaves atlas, Cartesian, Noetherian, DVR, qcqs, etale, proper and 'Theorem~5.1' untranslated, and contains a typo '带有所左 \(G\)-作用'. It is also the only file that rewrites the section title as \texorpdfstring{$\theta$-分层}{…} with a lowercase \theta, introducing a macro (and a symbol-case error) absent from the source, and it leaves a stray \text{ } in the \(\pi_0\) formula.

Accurate and complete; terminology is consistent, with 图卡 for 'chart' kept distinct from 图表 for 'diagram' (e.g. 「对数概形……的\textit{图卡}」 vs 「交换图表」), and terms like integral/fine/saturated rendered standardly as 整的/细的/饱和的. Minor blemishes: several inline conditions inside math are left in English, e.g. \(f \text{ is invertible outside } D\) and \((a,b)\sim(c,d) \text{ if there exists } s\in P\), so a few short phrases are not translated. Its 'toric variety' is 环簇 rather than the more usual 环面簇, and 'ghost sheaf' becomes 鬼层 rather than 幽灵层.

Very accurate, natural and complete; standard terms are used throughout (精细, 幽灵层, 整的, and the site rendered as 景, e.g. 「小 étale 景上的幺半群层」), and the inline math conditions are translated. Weaknesses are small: 'chart' is rendered by the bare character 图 (versus 图表 for diagram), which is slightly ambiguous, and '1-pointed curve' loses the marking (「光滑的 1 点曲线」, compare A's 「1 点标记曲线」), with 'n-pointed log curve' also just 「n 点对数曲线」.

Faithful and readable, but two recurring problems. 'Chart' and 'diagram' are both rendered 图表, so a sentence like 「\(P_X\to M_X\) 和 \(Q_Y \to M_Y\) 是图表，且图表……交换」 uses the same word for two different notions. In the FKato theorem 'integral' is mistranslated as 对数积 (「映射 \(\pi\) 是对数光滑的对数积（integral）映射」) even though the same term is correctly 整的 elsewhere; it also adds 典范 in 「它们同样定义了典范对数结构」 where the English only says 'define log structures', and leaves the same English inline conditions as A.

The translation is complete and reads smoothly, but it systematically mistranslates 'integral' as 对数积 (「称 \(P\) 是\textit{对数积（integral）}的」 and 「有限生成、精细、对数积、饱和」), including in the definitions of an integral monoid, an integral map and an integral log curve, while elsewhere it simply leaves the English word 'integral'. It also leaves many key terms untranslated (fine, saturated, sharp) and, like C, uses 图表 for both 'chart' and 'diagram', which weakens terminology and readability.

Accurate, complete and the most natural of the seven; standard terminology is consistent (整的, 精细的, 幽灵层, étale as 平展, site as 景), 'chart' is clearly introduced as 卡（chart）and used consistently, and even the inline math conditions are translated (「\(f\) 在 \(D\) 之外可逆」). Only tiny nits: '1-pointed curve' is 「光滑的 1 点曲线」, dropping the marking, and 一般点 is used for both 'general' and 'generic' points.

Content is faithful and complete and all equations are preserved, but the Chinese is buried under constant bilingual glosses (monoid, divisorial log structure, chart, fan, cone complex, …), making it the least fluent version. There is a stray Japanese hiragana in 「它是如下图表の上极限（colimit）」, and terminology slips: colimit as 上极限 (elsewhere 余极限) and 'contact order' as 相切阶 instead of 接触阶.

The prose reads well and nothing is omitted, but one central term is systematically wrong: 'fine' is translated 有限的 (finite), e.g. 「幺半群 \(P\) 是\textit{有限的}（fine）」 and 「有限对数概形」/「有限幺半群」, which changes the mathematical meaning throughout and collides with genuine 'finite'. It also mistranslates 'normal crossings divisor' as 法相交除子 instead of 正规交叉除子, uses the nonstandard 卡氏 for 'Cartesian', and leaves 'site' in English (「小 étale site」).

Faithful and very readable; e.g. '其中 \(\mc{C}\) 是万有曲线' and the long \(F_1\) align* computation are rendered cleanly, and all environments, figures and footnotes are present. Terminology is mostly standard (顶针, 预稳定, 胀子, 虚拟基本类, 本征的), but 'working over the Novikov ring / C[[q]]' is twice mistranslated as '在 Novikov 环上展开' / '在系数 C[[q]] 下展开'. Minor inconsistency: '赋值态射' early vs '赋值映射' later, and '祖先/后裔' for ancestors/descendants.

Complete and accurate with natural prose; '该积分与 I 函数被同一个 Picard--Fuchs 方程湮灭' and the Chang-Guo-Li theorem are correct. Terminology is good (重言类, 预稳定, 伸缩子, 平坦单位元), though evaluation morphism is rendered '取值态射/取值映射' and \(\delta_{k,\text{even}}\) is translated to \(\delta_{k,\text{偶数}}\) inside math. No mathematical drift found.

Content is complete and mathematically faithful, but more literal: '是真的' for proper and 'Lefschetz 喉管' for Lefschetz thimble are clear terminology errors, and '膨胀子方程' for the dilaton equation is nonstandard. Fluency suffers from translationese such as '它们由相同的公式给出，只是用...代替'. It does use standard '后代/求值态射/重言类' and consistent full transliteration (格罗莫夫-威滕, 弗罗贝尼乌斯).

Complete, accurate and generally fluent; terminology is consistent and often glossed ('真（proper）', '数值有效（nef）', '重言类', '后代'). However 'Lefschetz 闭链' renders thimble as a (closed) cycle, which is wrong, and '膨胀子方程' is nonstandard for dilaton. There is one redundant clause: '这给出（分次）维数 \(\chi(V)\)，也就是 \(V\) 的（分次）维数'.

The most consistently standard terminology (紧合的 for proper, 顶针 for thimble, 伸缩子, 预稳定, 重言, 平展覆叠) and accurate throughout; English glosses like '（mirror quintic）' and '（dilaton shift）' aid the reader. Prose is natural and the long align* computations match the source exactly. Only cosmetic issue: inline math often lacks surrounding spaces (e.g. '模空间\(\Mbar_{g,n}\)上的积分'), which is harmless in Chinese LaTeX.

Complete and faithful, with helpful English glosses ('顶针（thimble）', '胀子方程（dilaton equation）'). Terminology slips: '前稳定' for prestable, 'KdV 谱系' for the KdV hierarchy, and '典范类/典范关系' for tautological class/relations (should be 重言). Display equations have many added/removed sentence-final periods, sometimes leaving fragments such as '例如当 \(X\) 为 Calabi-Yau 三维簇时的 \[...\]。'

Accurate and fluent, complete, with good terminology (重言类, 预稳定, KdV 方程族, 固有的). Lefschetz thimble is left in English while the rest is Chinese, and '膨胀子方程/位移' is a questionable rendering of dilaton. Display equations drop some source punctuation, and one line calls the operator itself 'Picard-Fuchs 方程' ('这个算子恰好是...方程'), a small category slip.

Faithful and complete; every environment, footnote and \cite key is preserved. It renders 'proper map' as 本征映射 five times, which is nonstandard (本征 normally signals 'eigen-'); 紧合映射/真映射 would be expected. It also leaves the English fragment \text{relevant} inside the decomposition display while using 相关 in the prose, a small inconsistency.

Complete and mostly faithful, but it breaks the Verdier-duality sentence: the paragraph ends with '并通过函子 \[D_Y ...\]' and the predicate '满足 Verdier 对偶性。' is moved inside the next \begin{defn}, so the perverse-sheaf definition begins with a stray sentence and the preceding one has no verb. It also writes \ab(\text{维数为 } 4), dropping 'a summand of' from 'a summand of dimension 4'. Terminology is otherwise sound (固有映射, 保持典范类的奇点消解 for crepant).

Accurate and complete, with strong terminology: 真映射 for proper, \emph{W}-主齐性空间 for the W-torsor, 支撑/余支撑 conditions and 相交同调 all standard. The only blemishes are two English fragments left in the math (\text{relevant} and \text{a summand of dimension } 4) while the prose uses 相关, plus a single glossed '（stratum）'.

Accurate and complete; it restructures the Verdier sentence cleanly ('并满足 Verdier 对偶，对偶函子为 \[D_Y ...\]') and adds clarifying glosses such as 真（proper）态射 and 相关的（relevant）. Minor weaknesses: the torsor is called '\emph{W}-扭', and it too leaves \text{relevant} and \text{a summand of dimension } 4 untranslated inside the displays.

Very faithful and complete, using standard mainland terminology (紧合映射 for proper, 相交同调, 反常层, 中间延拓) and correctly translating the decomposition summand as '一个 4 维的直和项'. Its one clear slip is '\emph{W}-旋子' for the W-torsor (旋子 normally means 'spinor'; 挠子/主齐性空间 is meant). Inline math is consistently set with no surrounding spaces, a minor readability quirk.

Careful and complete, adding helpful bracketed English glosses throughout. But it mistranslates 'crepant resolution' as 同调平凡解消 ('homologically trivial'), which is wrong, and uses the nonstandard 可构层 for constructible sheaf (elsewhere 可构造层). It also renders 'two copies of the standard representation' as 两个标准表示的直和 and adds 不妨取 where the English has none.

Accurate, complete and structurally clean, and the prose reads naturally. Terminology is the weak point: 交同调 and 交复形 for intersection homology/complex (should be 相交同调/相交复形), '\emph{W}-主丛' for the torsor, and the theorem headers '[K\"unneth formula]' and '[Leray/Serre spectral sequence]' are left in English while the running text translates them as 谱序列.

Very faithful and complete: every environment, equation and even the large commented-out figure block are preserved exactly. Terminology is mostly standard, but proper morphism is rendered '本征态射' (standard would be '固有态射'/'紧合态射') and fake invariants as the rare '赝不变量'; the translator also invents Chinese names ('李元斌', '瞿枫') for Lee and Qu. Fluency is excellent, punctuation is consistently full-width, and macros/labels/refs are untouched. Among the cleanest files, but the nonstandard '本征态射' is a small terminology ding.

Accurate and complete, with the most standard terminology of the seven ('固有态射' for proper, '伪不变量' for fake invariants, '伸缩子方程' for the dilaton equation). Reads naturally; only minor clunky phrasing such as '某个 r \ge 2 对应的 r 次单位根'. It wraps the two long displayed propositions in {\small} (a harmless formatting change) and otherwise preserves all macros, labels and equations byte-for-byte. A near publishable translation.

Faithful and complete; uses standard terms such as '真（proper）态射', but leaves 'fake' and 'stem' untranslated and coins '多霍奇层' for pluri-Hodge where others write '多重 Hodge'. It transliterates Gromov-Witten as '格罗莫夫–威滕' only in the opening sentence and then reverts to 'GW'. A missing blank line before two subsection commands is purely cosmetic and does not affect output. Fluent and accurate overall.

Content is accurate and complete; the two displayed equations in the KdV passage are reordered but mathematically identical to the source. Main defects are typographic: Chinese quotation marks are typed as ASCII double quotes in '计数' and '超大', which render as straight quotes rather than full-width curly quotes, and en-dashes are frequently replaced by hyphens ('Deligne-Mumford', 'Calabi-Yau'). Terminology is mostly fine but '惰性叠' for inertia stack is nonstandard (it is glossed in English), and '托德类' replaces the more common 'Todd 类'.

Accurate, complete and very fluent, with standard terminology ('紧合态射' for proper morphism, '伪（fake）不变量', '轨形' for orbifold). It leaves 'adelic' in the section heading ('Adelic 刻画') and uses very tight Chinese/mathematical spacing, but no meaning is lost and all equations, figures, labels and citations are present. Together with B it is the most readable version of this unit.

Rendered content is accurate and complete, and it helpfully glosses many terms in English ('完备态射（perfect morphism）', '惯性叠（inertia stack）'). The real problem is terminology: '完备' is used indiscriminately for proper morphism, perfect morphism, perfect complexes and perfect obstruction theory, conflating 固有/紧合 with 完美, and '多倍 Hodge' for pluri-Hodge is odd. It is also the only file that drops the large commented-out figure block (no effect on output). Fluent, but the added English parentheticals are noisy.

Content is accurate and complete, including the commented figure, but presentation is the weakest of the seven: every piece of Chinese punctuation is half-width ASCII (',' ';' ':' and straight double quotes around '计数'), '丛胚' is an invented rendering of 'gerbe', '扭转扇形'/'无扭扇区' for twisted sector is both inconsistent and uses 扇形 wrongly, and '引力下降部分' for gravitational descendants is awkward. It also mixes renderings of 'perfect' ('完美阻碍理论' vs '完全复形') and has grammar slips such as '在所有亏格由 Ionel–Parker 得到'. Accurate but below the others in polish.

Faithful and complete, with natural academic Chinese (e.g. 「因此发生变化的是带有 \leq 2 个特殊点的亏格 0 曲线」, 「气泡的极限落在 F_{\star,d_0} 中，其中公共零点远离结点」). Minor terminology slips: stack is rendered 「栈」 rather than the standard 「叠」 (「Deligne–Mumford 栈」, 「开子栈」), the mirror map as 「镜面映射」 instead of 「镜像映射」, and the dilaton equation as 「胀子方程」. It also leaves the English text inside the F_{\star,d} display untranslated (「\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}」).

Accurate and complete, with correct standard terms (「完美障碍理论」, 「局部完全交奇点」, proper as 「固有」, dilaton as 「伸缩子」). The concrete defect is LaTeX: it wraps the QG(X,d) display and the master-space integral in extra {\small ...} groups, which changes the rendered output. It also renders 'fixed locus' as the looser 「不动点部分」 and wall-crossing as 「过墙」, but the prose is otherwise fluent and faithful.

Faithful and structurally exact, but leaves strings untranslated: the example headers remain [Second toy example]/[Another toy example], and the F_{\star,d} display keeps 「\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}」 in English. It subtly weakens 'nonvanishing' to 「(v_1, v_2) 不恒为零」 (not identically zero, rather than nowhere zero), and has awkward phrasing such as 「Hassett's 的加权带点曲线模空间」. Equations, labels and environments are otherwise preserved exactly.

Very accurate and complete with natural phrasing (e.g. 「它们有无穷多个自同构」, 「其中镜像变换为 Q = q \exp(I_1/I_0)」, proper as 「真（proper）」). It leaves 'torsor' in English (「等价于一个 \C^{\times}-torsor」), renders 'nonvanishing' as the slightly weak 「(v_1, v_2) 不全为零」, and keeps the English text inside the F_{\star,d} display; no LaTeX problems, and all environments are present.

Accurate and complete, with good standard renderings (proper = 「紧合」, dilaton = 「伸缩子」) and clean LaTeX. Terminology is a little idiosyncratic: wall/chamber as 「壁/腔」, torsor as 「旋子」 (more usually 「挠子」), and bubble as the terse 「泡」. Phrasing such as 「可见泡的极限落在 F_{\star, d_0} 中」 remains clear, and all definitions, examples and remarks are present.

Complete and faithful, but adds many parenthetical English glosses absent from the source (「主空间（master space）」, 「墙与室（wall and chamber）结构」, 「纠缠尾（entangled tail）」), which read as additions. More importantly, it mistranslates 'perfect obstruction theory' as 「完备障碍理论」 (should be 「完美障碍理论」; 完备 is also used for 'proper', as in 「完备 DM 叠」), and edits the LaTeX: several displays gain trailing periods/commas and the étale arrow becomes \xrightarrow{\text{平展}}. Prestable is rendered 「前稳定」 rather than 「预稳定」.

Accurate and essentially complete, but the Chinese text uses ASCII punctuation throughout—half-width commas, colons and parentheses, e.g. 「问题已由 Givental 与 Lian–Liu–Yau 解决。...见~\cite{CFK2014,CFK2020},而稳定拟映射...」 and 「不动点轨迹由 x_0 = 0 处的一个 \P^{n-1} 以及一个点 [1, 0, \ldots, 0] 组成;」—which is not standard for Chinese academic writing and makes the unit read unpolished. It also renders 'quintic threefold' as the dimension-losing 「五次超曲面」, 'virtual cycle' as 「虚循环」, and 'nonvanishing' as 「(v_1, v_2) 不全为零」; the math and all environments are otherwise preserved.

Accurate and complete: every environment, equation and figure is present and no mathematical claim is changed. Terminology is mostly standard, but it renders stack as 栈 (the brief prefers 叠) and proper as 本征, e.g. '本征且对数光滑' for 'proper and log smooth'. Prose is natural and punctuation is fully Chinese-style; only these lexical choices distinguish it.

Uses very standard terminology (固有 for proper, 叠 for stack, 丰沛 for ample, 预稳定) and is complete. However the final corollary is grammatically broken: '当 (X, V) 时，上述猜想蕴含 Z 的 Yamaguchi--丘成桐有限生成性' should read '关于 (X,V) 的上述猜想…'. It also uses 虚圈 for 'virtual cycle' and 临界点集 for 'critical locus', which are less standard.

Accurate and complete with natural, consistent prose. It renders proper as 真 ('它不是真的', '是真且对数光滑'), which is ambiguous because 真 normally means 'true', and leaves 'orbifold'/'conifold' untranslated in the footnote ('orbifold 正则性以及 conifold gap 条件'). Minor slip: '一个带有无标记点 C 的图' misparses 'with C unmarked' as 'with unmarked point C'.

Accurate, complete and fluent, and it helpfully appends English glosses for key terms (装饰热带型（decorated tropical type）, 一致极大退化（uniform maximal degeneracy）, 超势（superpotential）, 平衡条件（balancing condition）). It uses 真 for 'proper' and 靶 for 'target', which are less standard than 固有/紧合 and 目标, and 虚类 for 'virtual cycle'. Otherwise terminology and LaTeX are clean.

Accurate and complete, with the most standard core terminology of the set (紧合 for proper, 丰沛 for ample, 叠 for stack, 预稳定, 虚拟闭链, 完美障碍理论). Minor slips: '光滑零点集' for 'smooth zero section' and 'Fano 四维流形'/'Calabi-Yau 三维流形' for fourfold/threefold, where 簇 would be more standard. Fluent and consistently punctuated, though it omits spaces around inline math throughout.

Complete and otherwise fluent, but it systematically mistranslates 'proper' as 专有 (proprietary), in seven places: '它不是专有的', '专有且对数光滑', '一个带有基本/极小对数结构的专有 DM 叠', '专有临界轨迹'. It also uses 充裕 for 'ample', 前稳定 for 'prestable' and '锥流形间隙条件' for 'conifold gap condition'. Apart from these terminology problems the rendering is accurate and readable.

Complete and accurate in meaning, but the prose uses ASCII commas and half-width parentheses throughout (396 ASCII commas and zero full-width '，'), e.g. '设 X 是一个光滑射影簇(甚至是 DM 叠)'. Terminology is frequently nonstandard: 超级势 for 'superpotential', 虚循环 for 'virtual cycle', 阻碍理论 for 'obstruction theory', 完全相交 for 'complete intersection', 零点集 for 'zero section'. Otherwise the content matches the source.

Accurate and complete throughout, with standard, consistent terminology such as 五次三维流形, 亏格 and 模空间. The key quantifier is preserved ("弦方程给出…除非 (g,n,β)=(0,3,0)") and "be symplectic" is correctly rendered as "为辛空间". Every environment, equation and footnote is present, and all \label/\Cref/\cite keys are unchanged. Publishable as is.

Very fluent and complete, but has one mathematical slip: "设 H=… 为辛变换" renders "be symplectic" as "symplectic transformation" instead of a symplectic (sub)space; the other translations correctly write 辛空间/是辛的. Otherwise the meaning is faithful (e.g. "从 h<g 的 F_h 计算 F_g") and terminology such as 五次三维簇 and 二分图 is consistent. One display is reformatted into a gathered environment, which is output-equivalent.

Complete and mostly accurate, but several \text{} strings are left in English ("\text{ effective}", "\text{ exists}", "\text{for }"), which reads unfinished. Gromov–Witten is rendered inconsistently, mixing "五次格罗莫夫–威滕理论" with "Gromov-Witten 理论" and "五次三维簇 Gromov-Witten 理论". Otherwise terminology is standard and the mathematics is preserved.

Faithful and complete, with careful wording (e.g. "把五次公式置于一般镜像对称的图景中"). It keeps the English \text{} strings ("\text{ effective}", "\text{ exists}", "\text{for }") and mistranslates the table caption "Leading BPS invariants" as "主要 BPS 不变量" (should be 前几项/首批). "conifold" is left in English, but terminology is otherwise consistent and no content is omitted.

Fully translated and idiomatic, with standard terminology (五次三维流形, 轨形点, 亏格二) and everything present. \text{ exists} becomes "存在" and the accompanying text is natural ("锥形奇点（conifold point）", "壁穿越" for wall-crossing). Environment-by-environment it matches the source, and every label/\Cref/\cite key is preserved. Publishable as is.

High quality: complete, accurate and readable, with helpful parenthetical English glosses (e.g. "原生不变量（primary invariants）", "多重覆盖变换（multicover transformation）"). Terminology is standard and Gromov-Witten is rendered consistently; the only quibble is "锥流形点" for conifold, which is less standard than 锥形点. All environments, equations, labels and citations are intact.

Complete and generally accurate, but "orbifold" is mistranslated as "轨道点" (orbit) instead of "轨形点", appearing in "轨道点处的正则性", "轨道正则性" and "轨道边界条件". The quintic is called "五次超曲面" throughout even though the table caption still says "五次三维流形", an internal inconsistency. Author names are left in English (Liu--Ruan, Chang--Guo--Li, Guo--Janda--Ruan), which is acceptable; otherwise the rendering is careful.

Accurate, complete and very readable: all environments, labels, \Cref/\cite keys and every displayed formula match the source exactly. Terminology is its weak point, though: toric is rendered as bare '环' ('非紧的环 Calabi--Yau 三维簇', '环图') instead of '环面', proper is mistranslated as '本征' ('不是本征的'), and the conifold is called '锥形点'. It also silently normalizes hyphenation to en-dashes ('Calabi--Yau', 'Gromov--Witten').

Clean and faithful throughout, with standard terms ('环面图', '不固有', '标架') and perfect environment/equation preservation. Only small blemishes: '一亏格部分' is an awkward way to say 'the genus-one part', and the 'structural ansatz' becomes '结构表达式猜想', shifting 'ansatz' to 'conjecture'; like A it also rewrites the source hyphens as 'Calabi--Yau'/'Gromov--Witten'.

Content is complete and correct, and the source's hyphenation is preserved, but the prose has several small slips. 'proper' is rendered as the ambiguous '不是真的', the pairing sentence reads '配为' instead of '配对为', and there is a stray space in '许景毅和 张庆生'; numerous terms are left in English ('remodeling', 'conifold', 'Lefschetz thimble'), which is defensible but makes it less polished.

Complete and accurate, with consistent full sinicization of names ('格罗莫夫–威滕', '伯努利数') and a correct '不是真（proper）的'. The main terminology flaw is rendering a Lefschetz thimble as 'Lefschetz 鞘' (the standard term is '顶针'), while 'conifold', 'framing' and 'remodeling' are left in English; otherwise the prose is smooth.

Meaning, structure and all mathematics are preserved, and standard terms such as '紧合' and '标架' are used. However its typography is markedly worse: it almost never leaves a space before inline math (about 175 occurrences of the form '当\(p = 0\)时' versus 2 spaced instances), making the text dense and hard to read, and it calls the threefold a '三维流形' rather than '三维簇'; phrases like '有趣的是点' also read awkwardly.

The most fluent of the set, accurate and complete, and it correctly uses standard renderings like '标架' and 'Lefschetz 顶针'. Two reservations: it mistranslates proper as '专有' ('不是专有的', meaning proprietary), and it repeatedly inserts parenthetical English glosses ('半射影的（semiprojective）', '双标度极限（double-scaling limit）') that are additions absent from the source.

The strongest version: accurate, complete, idiomatic and terminologically consistent with '标架', '顶针', '固有', '伯努利数' and a translated '重塑猜想'. It preserves the source's hyphenation and every label/\Cref/\cite exactly, and reads naturally ('我们可以在 q=1 处看出这个上界'). Only a minor imprecision: it calls the Calabi-Yau threefold a '三维流形' rather than '三维簇'.

Meaning is faithful and complete, but the parenthetical is a dangling noun phrase ("除我本人与郭帅的报告之外的所有报告; 其中部分图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的") and "以便它了解" adds an unstated subject. Punctuation is inconsistent ASCII ("请注意, 所有报告" with half-width comma and semicolon) plus a stray space in "温耀雄 指出". Keeping "log GLSM" in English is a defensible choice.

Fluent and complete, but it misplaces the parenthetical's scope: "除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告外，笔记均为现场用 TeX 记录" claims the live-TeXing excluded the author's and Guo's talks, whereas the English says all notes were live-TeXed and only some figures were added later for other talks. Otherwise idiomatic ("对数 GLSM", "\textbf{实验性}转录"). Uses plain "TeX" instead of the \TeX macro.

The most faithful version: the parenthetical scope is exactly right ("除我本人以及郭帅的讲座外，部分插图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的") and "experimental" is correctly rendered in "\textbf{实验性} AI 转录稿". Full-width punctuation throughout, \TeX{} preserved, nothing omitted. Only very minor stylistic roughness ("讲座的现场 \TeX{} 笔记").

Accurate and complete, with correct parenthetical scope ("除我本人以及郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是事后使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入的") and good register ("在此一并致歉", "敬请告知"). "现场 TeX 速记稿" is an odd rendering of "live-TeXed" (速记 suggests shorthand), and plain "TeX" drops the \TeX macro. Consistent punctuation otherwise.

Content is complete and the parenthetical scope is right ("除我自己和郭帅的报告外，部分图片是后来用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补上的"). "试验性" is a weaker choice than 实验性 for experimental, and "\textbf{试验性}地由 AI 生成的转写稿" reads as translationese. Register is a bit colloquial ("我自己", "他的幻灯片"), and plain "TeX" drops the macro.

Shares B's scope error: "除我本人及郭帅的课程外均为现场录入" wrongly restricts the live-TeXing claim, and "讲义中的疏漏" narrows "errors" to omissions. Systematically mistranslates talks/lectures as courses ("郭帅两节课程", "除我的课程外"), which is wrong for a summer-school talk series. LaTeX is fine (\TeX{} kept), and "仍请随时告知" adds a small "随时".

Accurate and complete, correctly scoping the figure parenthetical ("除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是在会后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补充插入的") and catching the emphatic "did give" in "虽然我确实让 Claude 阅读过". Minor blemishes: "现场 TeX 记录笔记" is redundant, "\textbf{实验性}地由 AI 生成的转录" ends abruptly (转录稿 better), and a stray space in "感谢 周祐正". Plain "TeX" instead of \TeX.

Faithful and idiomatic throughout, with standard, consistent terminology (栈/广群/图册/斜率/滤过, e.g. "称向量丛 E 是半稳定的，如果 \[\mu(F)\leq\mu(E)\] 对每个非零真饱和子层 F\subset E 都成立"). All environments, labels, cites and math are preserved exactly. Only blemishes: English prose left untranslated inside displays ("E \text{ is a vector bundle on } C\times T"), and "Noether 代数栈" for Noetherian.

Accurate overall and good terminology (叠/群胚/固有), but with clumsy spots: the slope-stability definition is restructured awkwardly ("若向量丛 E 对每个非零真饱和子层满足 \[\mu(F)\leq\mu(E)\] 上述不等式（其中子层记为 F\subset E）"), and the formula text "\ab\{\text{其中的同构类：}\mf{X}(K)\}" is garbled. "Cartesian 图表" is left untranslated and "S 等价" drops the hyphen; the table gained @{} columns and \text fragments inside math were translated somewhat awkwardly ("E \text{ 是如下空间上的向量丛：} C\times T").

Faithful and readable, with good choices such as "真（proper）的", "余特征标" and "零调的", but three definition headers are left in English ("[informal]", "[Slope stability]", "[S-equivalence]") and English text remains inside formulas ("E \text{ is a vector bundle on } C\times T"). Small fluency slips: "指派 T 上一族族的同构类的集合", "或等价地等价于有限生成分次局部自由" and "为不动点轨迹分解为连通分支的分解". Math, labels and citations are intact apart from one added comma in a display.

One of the strongest: precise and consistent terminology ("诺特代数叠", "余特征标", "精细模空间、粗模空间与好模空间", "平展邻域") and very fluent academic Chinese. English glosses are used consistently and helpfully ("图册（atlas）", "真（proper）的", "\Theta\)-层（stratum）"), though somewhat heavily. Only "[informal]" and the \text fragments in displays are left untranslated; all math and labels are preserved exactly.

Fluent and complete, but terminology wobbles: proper is rendered as the nonstandard "紧合" ("分离代数叠的稳定子群是紧合的，而 \G_m 不是紧合的"), filtration as "滤链" (elsewhere 滤过), and stratum as "分层片" while the definition itself says "\(\Theta\)-层". Headings use a bare unicode Θ ("Θ-分层") inconsistent with \Theta in the body, and "Cartesian 图表"/"Noether 代数叠" are left half-translated; the math content itself is accurate.

Readable, complete and well glossed, but with a systematic terminology error: perfect complex is translated as "完备复形" ("\(\det(\L_\alpha^+)\) 和 \(\on{rk}(\L_\alpha^+)\) 分别表示完备复形 \(\L_\alpha^+\) 的行列式和虚秩"; standard is 完美复形) and proper as "完备（proper）", conflating two notions under one nonstandard word; "HN-特化性" is also nonstandard (特殊化). Punctuation is added inside display equations and "Jordan--H\"older" becomes Unicode "Hölder", so the math is not preserved exactly; "被一个概形或代数空间所可表" is awkward.

Competent and complete, with good terms ("固有的（proper）", "完美复形"), but marred by inconsistencies and slips: all three headings use "$\theta$-分层" instead of \Theta ("\texorpdfstring{$\theta$-分层}{Theta-stratifications}") while the body correctly uses \Theta. Errors include the ungrammatical "带有所左 G-作用的概形", the wrong measure word "每条线丛", a dropped "locally" in the footnote ("大致上是有限表现的"), and "T 上一族同构类的集合" losing "families over T"; "Cartesian 图" and "atlas" are left untranslated.

Faithful and idiomatic throughout, with consistent standard terminology (幺半群, 整的/精细的/饱和的/尖锐的, 图卡, 平展, 泛点 correctly distinguished from 一般点, e.g. "在泛点或一般光滑点 eta 处"). Every environment, diagram and the tikz figure is preserved verbatim. Only blemishes: three \text{} phrases are left in English inside math ("if there exists", "is invertible outside D", "if n = 0") and the \cite postnote is localized to "\cite[定理~3.5]"; "小平展站点" for the small étale site is slightly odd.

Complete and accurate with polished prose ("幺半群是带有单位元的交换半群"), and good terms such as 叠 and 幽灵层. Terminology slips: generic points are conflated with general points as "一般点" (also "x = 0 的一般点 eta_x"), toric boundary becomes "环面边界", and Cartesian diagrams are left as "Cartesian 图"; "a union of two rational curves" is rendered as "两条有理曲线相交得到的曲线" (intersection, not union). The \text{} in math is translated but awkwardly ("在如下集合外可逆：D"), and \cite[定理~3.5] is localized.

Complete and largely faithful, but with several terminology errors: the integral map in "映射 \pi 是对数光滑的对数积（integral）映射" is called "对数积" (= log product), and generalization maps become "广义化映射" ("对应于标记点的广义化映射"), where 泛化/一般化 is meant. Terminology is also inconsistent: "精细的（fine）" is introduced but later left as English "fine 子幺半群", and "它们同样定义了典范对数结构" adds "canonical" not in the source. Prose shows translationese ("或者我们退化目标"), and some \text{} stays in English.

Complete, accurate in content and quite readable, but systematically mistranslates "integral" as "对数积" ("P 是 对数积（integral）的", "精细（fine）的，若 P 有限生成且对数积"), a term meaning 'log product'; this clashes with the correct "整的" used by other passages' standard and makes "integral map" read as a product. Mixed policy of leaving "fine/integral/saturated" and "ghost 层" in English weakens consistency, and generic points are again "一般点". Math, labels and diagrams are preserved exactly.

Accurate, complete and natural, with sound terminology (整的, 精细的, 平展, 幽灵层, 万有族) and \text{} phrases properly translated ("在 D 之外可逆", "若 n = 0"). Minor issues: "domain curves" becomes "源曲线" rather than the standard 定义域曲线, generic points are conflated as "一般点" ("在 x = 0 的一般点 eta_x"), and chart is rendered as "卡" (glossed "（chart）"). Math, labels, \cite keys and the figure are all intact.

Complete and careful, correctly distinguishing "泛型点" from 一般点 and "特化/泛化" maps, but adds many English glosses absent from the source ("幺半群（monoid）", "整的（integral，或满足消去律的）") which clutter the text. Two clear blemishes: colimit is rendered "上极限" ("如下图表の上极限（colimit）", also with a stray Japanese の; standard is 余极限) and "piecewise linear" becomes "分片线性". "Working étale locally at a node" is calqued as "在结点 q 处平展局部地工作".

Complete and fluent, but systematically mistranslates "fine" as "有限的" ('finite'), e.g. "有限生成的、有限的、整的、饱和的" and Kato's hypothesis "Q 是有限幺半群", which changes the mathematical claim (a fine monoid is not a finite one) and collides with "有限生成". Other term errors: normal crossings divisor becomes "法相交除子" (should be 正规交叉除子), fan is rendered "扇形", and "smoothing parameter" becomes "磨光参数". Labels, \cite keys, equations and the tikz figure are preserved exactly.

Faithful and idiomatic throughout, with every environment, equation, figure and citation intact; the only content loss is in the CohFT definition, where "是一族 $S_n$-等变线性映射" drops the symbol name "a collection $\Omega_{g,n}$". Terminology slips: the Lagrangian cone is rendered "Lagrange 锥" (including the subsection title), evaluation morphism as "赋值态射", and stack as "栈". Math is identical to the source except the tikzcd labels become \text{遗忘映射}/\text{稳定化}, and "Chang-Guo-Li" is expanded to specific Chinese names ("张怀良–郭帅–李骏"), an unverifiable addition.

Accurate and complete, with good standard terminology (拉格朗日锥, Deligne--Mumford 叠, 固有, 伸缩子方程). Two glitches: "Lefschetz 膜" mistranslates thimble (顶针), and the Picard-Fuchs sentence is garbled ("I 函数被称为 \textit{Picard--Fuchs 方程}的微分方程湮灭"). Formulas are preserved except \delta_{k,\text{偶数}}/\text{奇数} replaces even/odd inside the math, and "积分仅当 $j = n+1$ 时可能非零" slightly weakens "the integral vanishes... unless".

Mathematically the most conservative: every formula is preserved verbatim (identical math to the source) and no paragraph or environment is missing. Terminology is the weak spot: thimble becomes "Lefschetz 喉管", dilaton "膨胀子", ancestors "先祖", and Gromov-Witten switches mid-document to the transliteration "格罗莫夫-威滕理论" after keeping "Gromov-Witten" earlier. The prose is somewhat literal (e.g. proper rendered as "是真的") but readable.

Consistently accurate and fluent, with a coherent transliteration policy (格罗莫夫–威滕, 卡拉比–丘, 弗罗贝尼乌斯) and the Lagrangian cone correctly as "拉格朗日锥". Minor terminology issues: "Lefschetz 闭链" for thimble, "先祖" for ancestors, "允许环" for loops, and "Euler 向量场" left in English in the last section after "欧拉向量场" in the first. All environments, figures, labels and formulae are intact.

The cleanest package: formulas match the source exactly (only the tikzcd labels 遗忘映射/稳定化 are translated) and terminology is sound (拉格朗日锥, "Lefschetz 顶针", 平展覆叠, Deligne--Mumford 叠). Flaws are small: "紧合的" for proper and "赋值态射/赋值映射" for evaluation are nonstandard, and half-width spacing is inconsistent ("归结为计算J 函数的问题"). Occasional added English glosses such as "（dilaton shift）" are harmless.

Readable and generous with bilingual glosses, but it mistranslates tautological as 典范 ("相伴典范类（tautological class）", "典范关系（tautological relations）"), colliding with "典范坐标" for canonical coordinates, and adds an incorrect gloss in "不会收到来自尾项（平移）的贡献" for tail contributions. "Lagrange 锥" is used for the Lagrangian cone (heading included). Formulas are complete but re-punctuated (periods moved out of display blocks) and several inline formulas are split or shifted across sentences.

Accurate overall and safe on names ("Chang-Guo-Li" kept in English), with good terminology (拉格朗日锥, 固有, 叠, 重言类). Weak points: the quintic threefold becomes "五次超曲面", loops become "允许环", "第二个图不接收尾部贡献" is literal translationese, and the formula translates even/odd inside math (\delta_{k,\text{偶}}/\text{奇}). Math is otherwise preserved with only punctuation moved out of display blocks.

Faithful and complete: every environment, footnote and display matches the English, including '我们明确拒绝定义它。' for the Whitney footnote and '两份标准表示' for 'two copies of the standard representation'. Terminology is standard and consistent (可构造层, 反常层, 半单, 局部系), though '本征映射' for proper and '解消' for resolution are slightly less usual than 固有/消解. Only tiny blemishes such as the literal '对所有层片 Y_λ 变动'. Reads as publishable academic Chinese.

Accurate and complete in content, with the best terminology of the batch (固有映射, W 扭子, '保持典范类的奇点消解', 't-结构的心'). The serious flaw is structural: the Verdier-duality sentence is split across environments, so the definition box starts with the dangling fragment '满足 Verdier 对偶性。复形 … 称为反常层'. The final align* is also reflowed into three lines and the summand text is reduced to '维数为 4', dropping 'a summand'. Otherwise fluent, concise academic Chinese.

Complete and faithful in meaning, but it consistently renders proper as 真 ('真映射', '真满态射', '由于 f 是真的'), a literal calque less standard than 固有/本征 in algebraic geometry; '某个 t-结构的核心' is likewise off for the heart of a t-structure. Calqued phrasing appears ('我们需要与其解析化打交道') and the semi-small definition gains an added gloss '层（stratum）'. It also leaves the fragment 'a summand of dimension 4' in English in the final display.

Very fluent and idiomatic ('遗憾的是，大多数空间并不是乘积'), and it handles the six-functor sentence cleanly ('并满足 Verdier 对偶，对偶函子为 …'). Incomplete only in the last displays, where 'a summand of dimension 4' and 'relevant' are left untranslated. Proper is rendered 真 with a one-time gloss '真（proper）态射' — defensible but nonstandard — and 'W-扭' for torsor is abbreviated; all math, labels and citation keys are preserved.

Complete and readable, with good renderings such as '一个 4 维的直和项' and 't-结构的心'. Terminology slips: torsor becomes 'W-旋子', which actually means spinor (should be 扭子/主齐性空间), and proper becomes '紧合映射/紧合满态射', which is uncommon. Spacing around math is inconsistent ('的crepant 消解') and the trailing period of the D_Y display is dropped; otherwise a solid translation with one wrong technical word.

Complete and quite fluent, but heavily annotated with English glosses ('局部系（local system）', '反常层（perverse sheaf）', '心（heart）') that are additions to the source. Two terminology choices are wrong: crepant is rendered '同调平凡解消（crepant resolution）' (homologically trivial is not crepant) and proper becomes '完备映射（proper map）', clashing with complete varieties. Also '两个标准表示的直和' slightly changes 'two copies of the standard representation', and 'Künneth' is written with a Unicode ü instead of 'K\"unneth'.

Generally fluent and complete, but the theorem headers are left in English ('[K\"unneth formula]', '[Leray/Serre spectral sequence]') and 'a crepant resolution … of singularities' is misread as '存在奇异的 crepant 解消' (a singular crepant resolution). Stratum is conflated with stratification ('若唯一的 relevant 分层就是稠密的那一个', '遍历所有分层'), and 'relevant' stays in English despite its own gloss '相关（relevant）'. Also '交同调'/'交复形' drop the 相 of 相交同调/相交复形.

Complete and faithful throughout, with every environment, equation, figure and footnote present and all math untouched. Terminology is mostly strong (栈 for stack, 赝不变量 for fake invariants, 臂/腿/尾 with glosses), but a few choices slip: evaluation maps are called 赋值映射 (usually 求值映射; 赋值 = valuation), the dilaton equation is 胀子方程, and descendants are 引力后裔. Prose is natural and fluent (「我们现在的目标是把这整个故事提升到 K-理论」), and the LaTeX is otherwise impeccable.

Very accurate and complete, with the best terminology of the set: 叠, 固有态射, 惯性叠, 伸缩子方程, 拉格朗日锥, 伪不变量/主干. Two typographic habits hurt it: sentences end with an orphan full stop placed on its own line after a display (e.g. 「\]。若 \(f\) 是完美态射」 and 「\]。下一步是证明」), and the two Givental--Tonita proposition displays are wrapped in extra {\small ...} groups that change the output. Also an awkward word order in 「基于它们的新的一亏格计算」 (should be 亏格一) and a redundant 「目标空间的稳定映射模空间…其中目标为 X」.

Accurate and complete; all lemmas, proofs and both figures are intact with math unchanged. It keeps fake 不变量 and stem in English (defensible) and uses 多霍奇/洛朗 consistently, but spacing of the key term is erratic (「提升到 K理论」, 「量子K理论」 vs 「K 理论的 GW 不变量」), and Gromov-Witten is rendered by transliteration 格罗莫夫--威滕 while all other technical names stay in English. Otherwise fluent, idiomatic academic Chinese.

Complete and faithful, with well-structured reordering that reads naturally (e.g. 「若固定 \(\mathbf{t}(q)\)，则 \(J(\tau)\) 来自 \(\tau\) 上弗罗贝尼乌斯流形的一个微分方程的基本解」). Terminology wobbles: inertia stack is 惰性叠 (standard is 惯性叠), universal cotangent line becomes 泛余切线, twisting is 扭变, and Riemann--Roch alternates between 黎曼--罗赫 and the untranslated form. Straight ASCII quotation marks around 「计数」 in the Overview are inconsistent with the Chinese punctuation used elsewhere.

Nothing omitted and the mathematics is exact, but proper is rendered as the nonstandard 紧合 (「沿紧合态射的前推」, 「这个模空间是一个紧合的 DM 叠」), and virtual is 虚拟结构层/虚拟切丛 where 虚 is the usual choice. Evaluation maps are again misnamed 赋值映射. The file also strips the spacing between Chinese text and inline math throughout (「光滑射影簇\(X\)」) and drops the final full stops on several displayed formulas, small but visible output changes.

Everything is present (the missing lines are only the source's commented-out figure) and the math, labels and cite keys are intact, but there is a systematic mistranslation of perfect/proper: perfect complexes and morphisms become 完备复形/完备态射, and the source's 'proper DM stack which has a perfect obstruction theory' becomes 「一个带有完备障碍理论的完备 DM 叠」, conflating the two notions. Other wrong or dubious terms: 「KdV 谱系」 for the KdV hierarchy, 胀子方程 for the dilaton equation, and Adele 刻画 (misspelled Adèle). On the other hand the English glosses (perfect obstruction theory, virtual tangent bundle) are genuinely helpful and the Chinese is fluent.

Content-wise this is one of the strongest: complete, faithful, with good terms such as 完全复形/完全态射, 固有态射 and 超椭圆轨迹. However, the entire file uses halfwidth punctuation in Chinese prose (commas, colons, parentheses: 「的数,其中」, 「定义为满足如下条件的函数 \(\tau\):」, 「(或者在对象上是 \(2:1\) 覆盖)」), which is a pervasive typesetting flaw for publication. Terminology slips include 引力下降部分 for gravitational descendents, 膨胀方程 for the dilaton equation, 丛胚 for gerbe, and 「descendant GW 不变量」 left in English after 引力下降部分 was used earlier.

Faithful and complete: all 3 defn/11 exm/4 rmk environments and every formula are present and mathematically unchanged. Terminology is mostly sound (墙交叉, 基点, 稳定商, 万有曲线), though toric variety is wrongly rendered 环簇 and quintic threefold as 五次三维流形. Fluency suffers from colloquialisms such as '它活在 H^*_{C×}(X)[[q]][z^{-1}] 中' and '它将沿 C×-作用直接行到自身', and the definition of F_{\star,d} is left untranslated: '\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}'. LaTeX is preserved exactly (labels, cites, tikzcd all intact).

The most accurate and idiomatic version: 'fixed and ... is not a common zero' is correctly rendered '固定且 (v=0) 不是公共零点', proper is 固有, toric variety 环面簇, lci 局部完全交, and the mirror map is correctly 镜像映射. Nothing is missing and the Chinese reads naturally throughout, e.g. '该式属于 H^*_{C×}(X)[[q]][z^{-1}]'. Only nits: wall-crossing is called 过墙 rather than the more usual 墙交叉, character is simplified to 特征, two displays are wrapped in added {\small}, and a stray '。' sits alone after one display. Math, labels and cites are otherwise exact.

Complete and mostly faithful, but with several slips: 'highly non-separated' becomes '高度不可分离' (which means highly inseparable), 'f is fixed if...' is garbled as 'f 不动，只需对所有的 t...交换', and proper is awkwardly left as '真（proper）的'. Both example titles are left in English ('\begin{exm}[Second toy example]', '[Another toy example]') and 'Hassett\textquotesingle s 的' / 'Hassett's 的' mixes English possessives with 的. The one untranslated math text '\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}' also survives; LaTeX itself is exact.

Complete and reliable, with clear phrasing such as '我们剩下 C = P^1 以及 I-函数的各种贡献'; all environments and formulas are intact. The main accuracy slip is rendering 'disjoint' as 互不相同 ('x_1, x_2, x_3 互不相同', '四个标记点互不相同') where 不相交 is meant. Terminology wobbles: proper is '真的（proper）' and '真 DM叠', mirror map becomes 镜像变换, torsor is left in English, and '\text{ fixed and } (v=0) \text{ is not a common zero}' is not translated.

Complete and correct in substance, and it does translate the F_{\star,d} text ('不动且 (v=0) 不是公共零点'). Terminology is the weak point: proper is rendered 非紧合的/紧合的, torsor as 旋子 (a wrong coinage; 挠子/主齐性空间 is meant), and wall/chamber as 壁/腔, plus 五次三维流形（quintic）. From the Master space section onward the spacing is inconsistent, with Latin/math run into Chinese ('考虑\(\P^n\)上由下式给出的'), though punctuation is otherwise consistent.

Careful and complete, with helpful inline glosses (master space, basepoint, entangled tail, quasimap with calibrated tails) that are reasonable rather than distracting. The terminology defect is '带有完备障碍理论的完备 DM 叠', where perfect obstruction theory should be 完美障碍理论 and proper 固有/本征; 玩具模型 for toy example and 前稳定 for prestable are debatable but usable. LaTeX is essentially preserved, but periods were added inside displays (e.g. '= \frac{I}{I_0}.') and the arrow label \text{\'et} was replaced by \text{平展}, so the output is not literally identical.

Mathematically complete and accurate (固有, 完美阻碍理论, 主齐性空间 for torsor are all defensible), but the punctuation is a persistent problem: halfwidth commas/colons/parentheses are used throughout Chinese prose ('若一个映射在该作用下不动,则其定义域必有某些分量...'), mixing with fullwidth periods. Terminology is uneven: node becomes 节点 rather than 结点, toric variety 环簇, chamber 腔, and quintic threefold is flattened to 五次超曲面, losing 'threefold'. All math, labels and environments are preserved exactly.

Faithful and complete: every environment, display formula and figure matches the source exactly, with standard, consistent terminology (本征 for proper, 丰沛 for ample, 预稳定, 接触阶, 虚拟闭链). Prose reads naturally, e.g. "态射 ... 性质很好，但它不是本征的", and names are handled sensibly (连文豪–刘克峰–丘成桐, Kiem–李骏). Only trivial blemishes: "conifold gap condition" becomes the slightly off 锥形点间隙条件, and the \cite optional argument is translated for 定理~1.16--1.17/定理~1.7 but left as Conjecture~1.6.

Complete and mathematically faithful, with solid vocabulary (固有 for proper, 丰沛, 叠). Minor rough edges: an added \enlargethispage{3pt} not present in the source, the awkward in-formula text "对所有如下元素均有界且非平凡：", 可表示 instead of 可表, and the elliptical final corollary "当 \((X, V)\) 时，上述猜想蕴含…". Cite optional arguments are inconsistently translated (only "定理~1.7").

Complete, with math, labels and figures preserved exactly, but it consistently renders proper as 真, producing the misleading "它不是真的" and "真 DM 叠", "真临界轨迹". Other slips: "被 \(e_{\max}\) 一致界住", ungrammatical "V 为丰富", and inconsistent naming of the ambient (环境 vs 周围空间). Cite notes are kept in English consistently, so the LaTeX output is clean.

Complete and accurate, with helpful English glosses ("一致极大退化（uniform maximal degeneracy）", "超势（superpotential）") and all formulas/labels intact. Like C it uses 真 for proper ("但它不是真的", "真 DM叠", "是真（proper）的"), which is nonstandard and reads badly, and "V 为丰富" is ungrammatical; virtual cycles are called 虚类. Everything else is fluent and faithful.

Complete and generally fluent, but it renders proper as the nonstandard coinage 紧合 ("不是紧合的", "紧合 DM 叠"), confusingly close to its own 紧型 (compact type). It also mixes 簇 and 流形 ("Calabi-Yau 三维流形", "Fano 四维流形", "五次三维流形") and garbles the last corollary: "上述猜想对 \((X, V)\) 成立蕴含…". All \cite notes are translated consistently (定理~1.16--1.17, 猜想~1.6), and formulas are preserved exactly.

Complete, readable and well glossed in English, but it mistranslates core terms: proper becomes 专有的 ("它不是专有的", "专有 DM 叠", "专有临界轨迹"), ample becomes "充裕线丛"/"充裕的", and prestable is "前稳定性"; "锥流形间隙条件" also misses conifold. Apart from these terminology errors the translation is accurate and fluent, and all LaTeX is preserved.

Complete with all formulas and labels preserved exactly, but it misplaces a hypothesis in the main theorem: "Fano 四维流形 \(X\) 中一个无奇数上同调的 Calabi-Yau 三维超曲面" makes "no odd cohomology" modify the hypersurface instead of X. The whole file uses half-width ASCII punctuation in Chinese text ("簇,带有截面", "有什么关系?"), and terms wobble (超级势, 完美阻碍理论, 簇/流形, 零点集/零点截面). Otherwise the rendering is sound (固有 for proper, 丰富 for ample).

Faithful and complete, with idiomatic academic Chinese and all math, labels and citation keys preserved exactly. Terminology is slightly marred by rendering 'quintic threefold' as '五次三维流形' (manifold rather than variety) and 'Calabi-Yau threefolds' as 'Calabi-Yau 三维流形' throughout, and 'conifold' as the nonstandard '锥形点'. Occasional register slips such as '把这些数打包进生成级数' are minor; quantifiers and hypotheses (e.g. '一旦 g > ... 就有 n_{g,d} = 0') are all correct.

Complete and generally accurate, but 'Let H = ... be symplectic' is mistranslated as '设 \(\mc{H} = ...\) 为辛变换' — H becomes a symplectic transformation instead of a symplectic space. Nonstandard terms recur: '二亏格' for genus two, '扭曲' for twisted, '二分图' for bipartite, '量子乘法' for quantum product. The Yukawa align* is split so C_111 and C_222 sit on separate rows, and the X_k display is rewrapped in a gathered environment, changing the typeset layout.

Accurate and complete, with every formula preserved character for character (the \text{effective}/\text{bipartite}/\text{exists} words are left in English inside the math). Word choices are sometimes off: 'legs' becomes '无脚' ('no feet') in the figure captions and prose, and 'holomorphic ambiguity' is rendered '全纯歧义' (linguistic ambiguity) throughout. Terminology is inconsistent: 'Gromov-Witten' and '格罗莫夫–威滕' are mixed within one unit, as are '其余图'/'剩余图' for rest graphs, and 'The bipartite graph sum' reads awkwardly as '二部图和'.

Accurate, complete and elegant, with math blocks preserved verbatim and good editorial glosses ('锥点（conifold point）', '间隙（gap）', '其余图（rest graphs）'). Small blemishes: 'normalized' wobbles between '正规化' and '规范化', 'universal' between '泛曲线' and '普适边', the footnote hybridises '格罗莫夫--Witten', and a few constructions are stiff ('以形式 \(R^{-1}(z) = R^*(-z)\) 使用辛条件').

Faithful and complete with all formulas preserved (trailing display punctuation moved into the prose, which is fine). The main terminology weakness is '五次三维流形' for 'quintic threefold' (and 'Calabi-Yau 三维流形') plus '扭曲' for 'twisted'; wall-crossing as '壁穿越' and strata as '分层片' are acceptable. Spacing around inline math is inconsistent between sections ('考虑\(X\)' vs '使用 \(t\)-扭曲'), and '把这些数打包成生成函数' is colloquial.

Polished prose and complete, with sensible English glosses ('rest graphs', 'rubber', 'stable-quotient'). Two terminology errors recur: 'primary invariants' becomes '原生不变量（primary invariants）' and 'conifold' is repeatedly rendered '锥流形' (cone manifold) in '锥流形点'/'锥流形间隙'; 'universal' also wobbles between '泛' and '普适'. Math, environments, labels and keys are all intact.

Complete and mathematically sound, prudently leaving author names in English (Liu--Ruan, Chang--Guo--You--Zhang). But the main object's name drifts between '五次超曲面' (title and body) and '五次三维流形' (table caption), 'orbifold point' is mistranslated '轨道点' (orbit point), and 'rational descendant insertions' is garbled as '带理后代插入' / '理后代插入'. Other oddities: '含糊性' for ambiguity, '领先部分/领先扇区' for leading part/sector, '修饰' for decorations.

Faithful and the most fluent of the set, with every environment and sentence present. The main flaw is recurring terminology: 'resolved conifold' is repeatedly rendered '已解消的锥形点' (a cone point, not a conifold) and 'toric Calabi-Yau threefold' as '环 Calabi--Yau 三维簇' (环 rather than 环面). It also expands surname citations into full Chinese names, e.g. '方博汉–刘秋菊–宗正宇' for Fang--Liu--Zong, a risky addition; 'Lefschetz 顶针' is at least literal.

Complete and accurate overall, but with small meaning shifts: 'ansatz' becomes '表达式猜想' (a conjecture, not an ansatz) and 'quantum product' is '量子乘法' instead of 量子乘积/量子积. Terminology is otherwise good ('环面 Calabi--Yau 三维簇', '不固有'), though 'Lefschetz 膜' for thimble is odd and '精确计算了一亏格部分' is a nonstandard word order for genus one. Reads fluently, at times a little telegraphic.

The safest terminology choices: uncertain terms are sensibly left in English ('解消锥形（resolved conifold）', 'conifold 奇点', 'Lefschetz thimble', 'remodeling 猜想'), and '拟设' is correctly used for ansatz. Small blemishes: a stray space in '许景毅和 张庆生', the elliptical '配为' for 'and pairing', and 'not proper' rendered '不是真的', which reads like 'not true'. Fluent and complete throughout.

The most faithful and consistent translation: Latin author names are kept as in the source ('Zhou', 'Fang--Liu--Zong'), Gromov-Witten is uniformly '格罗莫夫–威滕', and it uses good standard terms ('量子积', '求值映射', '解消锥（resolved conifold）', '不是真（proper）的'). Only cosmetic defects: a stray standalone comma after the total-free-energy display, a trailing \bigskip, and the slightly awkward '带框的 R-矩阵' for framed. Publishable quality otherwise.

Accurate and natural, but two clear terminology slips: 'threefold' becomes '三维流形' ('环面 Calabi-Yau 三维流形') and 'not proper' becomes '不是紧合的', an invented rendering. Also '赋值映射' for evaluation map and 'Lefschetz 顶针' are debatable. Math, labels and cross-references are preserved exactly and the argument flows well.

Complete and accurate, with helpful bilingual glosses ('（resolved conifold）', '（ansatz）', '（framing）') that nevertheless clutter the prose. The clearest error is 'not proper' rendered '不是专有的' (proprietary), and '这就是为什么当前情形未被现有文献所涵盖的原因' is a redundant why-because construction; '消解锥流形' for conifold is loose. It does use '三维簇', '求值映射' and '拟设' correctly.

Fluent but with the most meaning-level slips: 'whose action preserves the Calabi-Yau form' becomes '其作用保持 Calabi-Yau 型' (type, not the Calabi-Yau form), and 'threefold' becomes '三维流形'. Conifold terminology is inconsistent ('解消锥形流形' vs '普通的锥形奇点'), 'the fan of X_p' becomes 'X_p 的扇形', and 'Γ 函数' introduces a Unicode glyph where other files keep Gamma in Latin. Keeping 'Zhou', 'Chen-Li-Liu', 'Fang--Liu--Zong' in Latin is a safe choice.

Every clause of the English is present and correctly scoped, e.g. the figure caveat '除我本人与郭帅的报告之外…其中部分图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的'. But the text is set throughout with half-width commas and a half-width semicolon ('请注意, 所有报告…', '所有报告; 其中部分图'), plus a stray space ('温耀雄 指出'), which no Chinese publication would print. Meaning is unaffected, so it is a punctuation-style problem rather than a translation one.

By far the most natural, idiomatic Chinese of the seven, complete and consistently punctuated. But the first sentence changes the claim: '除我本人的报告和郭帅的报告外，笔记均为现场用 TeX 记录' implies the author's own notes were not live-TeXed, whereas the English says all the notes are live-TeXed and only the late figure insertion excludes those talks. The detached figure clause '部分插图后来使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入' also loses its explicit 'for all talks besides…' scope.

Faithful, complete and the cleanest of the seven: the exception stays on the figures ('除我本人以及郭帅的讲座外，部分插图是事后用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入的'), '实验性 AI 转录稿' renders 'experimental AI-generated transcriptions' exactly, and punctuation and the abstract environment are consistent. Only minor stiffness: '注意，' is terser than '请注意', and '我其余的笔记' slightly weakens 'all of my other notes'.

Accurate and complete, keeping the figure-insertion scope ('除我本人以及郭帅的报告之外，部分插图是事后使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补入的') with standard terminology and clean full-width punctuation. '现场 TeX 速记稿' is a slightly loose rendering of 'live-TeXed' (速记稿 suggests stenography) and '均以中文给出' is a touch stiff next to '以中文进行', but nothing is mistranslated.

Meaning is intact everywhere, including the figure caveat '除我自己和郭帅的报告外，部分图片是后来用 Codex 或 Claude Code 补上的'. But the transcription sentence is tangled ('是根据他的幻灯片试验性地由 AI 生成的转写稿' stacks adverbials unnaturally, and '试验性' is a less standard choice than '实验性'), and the register slips colloquial in places ('所有报告都是用中文讲的').

The opening parenthesis misreads the English: '除我本人及郭帅的课程外均为现场录入' moves the exception onto the live-recording itself, implying the author's own notes were not live-TeXed (contradicting both its own main clause and the source), and the detached '部分配图后来使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 插入' loses its scope. Also '疏漏' narrows 'any errors in my lectures' to omissions, and 'talks' is rendered '课程' inconsistently with '报告'.

Largely faithful and complete, and it nicely preserves the emphatic 'I did give' as '我确实让 Claude 阅读过'. But '是根据他的幻灯片实验性地由 AI 生成的转录' is as tangled as E's version of the same sentence, '现场 TeX 记录笔记' is redundant, '讲演' is dated for a summer-school lecture, and there is a stray space ('我要感谢 周祐正').

A near-publishable translation with consistent terminology (栈, 广群, 稳定化子, 丰沛线丛, 本征 for proper) and exact preservation of all labels, cite keys, the 64 display equations and both tikzcd diagrams. Its main lapses are rendering 'non-abelian localization' as '非交换局部化' (non-commutative) in the subsection and theorem titles, and leaving English text inside displayed formulas such as 'E \text{ is a vector bundle on } C\times T' and '\quad\text{for }\alpha\leq\beta'. Minor stiffness remains in phrases like '这恢复了 GIT' and the terse table row labels '细模/粗模/好模'.

Very faithful and readable, with solid choices throughout (叠, 群胚, 固有 for proper, 拟紧, 丰沛线丛); every environment and equation is present. The semistability definition is contorted into '若向量丛 E 对每个非零真饱和子层满足 [displayed μ(F)≤μ(E)] 上述不等式（其中子层记为 F⊂E）', and 'for some m≫0' is duplicated as '对某个充分大的整数…其中 m≫0'. It repeats the '非交换局部化' error for non-abelian and quietly alters the table's tabular preamble with '@{}' edge padding.

Accurate and structurally complete, but terminology is the weakest of the set: proper becomes '稳定化子群是真（proper）的', good quotient becomes '好的商', ample is '丰富线丛' (丰沛 is standard), and line bundle shifts between '可逆变' rendering '可逆层' and '线丛'. In-formula text stays in English ('E is a vector bundle on C×T', 'isomorphism classes in X(K)') and definition titles remain untranslated ([informal], [Slope stability], [S-equivalence]), with awkward bits like 'T 上一族族的同构类的集合'. 'Hilbert-Mumford' loses its en-dash.

Largely accurate and pleasant to read, with helpful English glosses (图册（atlas）, Θ-层（stratum）, 整体商（global quotient）). But the pushforward functor is mistranslated as '推出函子' (which means pushout), proper becomes '真（proper）', and ample is '丰富线丛'. Like C it leaves English text inside the displayed formulas ('E is a vector bundle on C×T') and inconsistently mixes translated definition titles ('[斜率稳定性]') with untranslated ones ('[informal]').

Fluent and faithful: it properly translates the in-formula text ('E \text{ 是 } C\times T \text{ 上的向量丛}', '对每个几何点'), keeps every environment, label and citation, and uses 紧合 for proper consistently. It shares the '非交换局部化' mistranslation of non-abelian, and its section/subsection headings use a literal Unicode 'Θ-分层' instead of \(\Theta\), inconsistent with the body's \(\Theta\). Filtration alternates between '滤链' (11×) and one stray '滤过' in '滤过对象的叠'.

A careful, heavily annotated rendering (叠, 群胚, glosses such as 平展（étale）, 虚拟秩) that alone among the top group gets '非阿贝尔局部化' right, translates all in-formula text, and preserves every label, cite key and the 64 display equations. Its weaknesses are using '完备' for both proper ('分离代数叠的稳定子群是完备的') and perfect ('完备复形'), colliding with complete, and one broken clause: '都能作为叠被一个概形或代数空间所可表'. The dense parenthetical glossing is a style cost rather than an error.

Complete and generally accurate, with correct '非阿贝尔局部化' and '完美复形' for perfect complex. It is let down by details: the headings read '$\theta$-分层' (lowercase θ via texorpdfstring) against the body's capital Θ, there is a typo '设 X 是一个带有所左 G-作用的概形', the footnote drops 'locally' from '局部有限表现' ('合理指大致上是有限表现的且对角 qcqs'), and '指定 T 上一族同构类的集合' loses the source's 'isomorphism classes of families'. Ample is '丰富线丛'.

Faithful throughout; all 26 examples, 20 definitions, 5 theorems, the lemma, remark, figure and every label preserved, and the math skeleton matches the source exactly. Terminology is consistent and sound (幺半群, 整的, 细的, 饱和的, 尖锐的, 环簇, 图卡 for chart, 穿孔曲线, 泛化映射). Reads naturally ('这恢复了把 X 表示为环簇的锥'). Only blemish: a few phrases inside math are left in English, e.g. '\text{ if there exists } s \in P' and '\text{ is invertible outside } D', where other translations produced Chinese.

Very accurate and complete, with fluent, idiomatic Chinese ('把光滑替换为 étale 也有同样结论', '在同构意义下不改变锥复形'). Weak points: 'chart' is translated as 图, which collides with 图表 for diagram ('对数映射的一个图是三元组…且下图交换' is confusing); 'étale' is left in English throughout; minor additions such as rendering 'the moduli of n-pointed prestable curves' as '模叠' and the clumsy '其奇异曲线所在部分是正规交叉除子' for singular locus. Math, labels and environments are preserved exactly.

Complete and generally faithful, with helpful English glosses ('整的（integral）', '精细的（fine）'), but it contains one real mistranslation: the FKato2000 theorem 'The map π is a log smooth integral map' becomes '映射 π 是对数光滑的对数积（integral）映射', where 对数积 (log product) is simply wrong for integral. Terminology is otherwise uneven: '图表' serves for both chart and diagram, '小 étale 拓扑' for small étale site, and the awkward '广义化映射' for generalization maps; fluency slips include '设 ρ_q 记…' and '一句口号是'.

Complete with clean LaTeX and mostly fluent prose, but the translation of 'integral' as '对数积' (log product) is systematic and appears in core definitions: '若 P 有限生成且对数积', '对数概形…是有限生成的、精细、对数积、饱和的', '对数曲线…是对数光滑且 integral 的映射' — actively misleading for a central term of the subject. Terminology is also inconsistent, switching between 精细/对数积 early and untranslated fine/fs/integral/saturated later, and 'intersection numbers' becomes the nonstandard '交数'.

The strongest overall: everything is present, the mathematics is untouched, and even the text inside math is translated ('f 在 D 之外可逆', 'm ≥ 0 若 n = 0'). Terminology is standard and consistent throughout (小平展景, 精细, 整的, 饱和的, 尖锐的, 卡 with gloss, 穿孔化 for puncturing, 万有族, 特殊化映射), and the Chinese is the most natural of the seven ('可以概括为一句口号：对数曲线就是预稳定曲线连同 M_S^can → M_S'). No substantive errors found.

Accurate in substance and complete, with abundant English glosses that partly redeem the terminology, but several nonstandard or wrong choices: generic point as '泛型点', 'n-标点对数曲线' (标点 means punctuation), '前稳定曲线' and '前对数结构' for prestable/pre-log, '上极限' for colimit (in Chinese this means limsup; the standard is 余极限), '相切阶' for contact order, '分片线性' for piecewise linear. There is also a stray Japanese character: '它是如下图表の上极限（colimit）'. Math and structure are otherwise preserved exactly.

Complete and structurally intact, but the terminology repeatedly changes mathematical meaning: 'fine' is translated as '有限的' throughout ('有限幺半群', '有限对数概形', '有限饱和的，fs'), so fine becomes finite; correspondingly '右边任何包含 N ⊕ N 的有限子幺半群都可以由某个穿孔实现' misstates the fine submonoid claim. Other errors: 'normal crossings divisor' as '法相交除子', 'smoothing parameter' as '磨光参数', nodal curve as '节点曲线' (节点 is a graph node; standard is 结点), '消没' for vanish, '泛族' for universal family. Prose is otherwise readable.

Complete and faithful: all 29 environments, both tikz figures, all labels and cite keys are preserved, and the display math is token-identical to the source (e.g. the virtual class paragraph '尽管 \(\Mbar_{g,n}(X, \beta)\) 一般是奇异的、不等维的且可约的...称为虚拟基本类' matches the English exactly). Minor issues: '本征' for proper (Taiwan convention), '环簇' for toric variety, mixing '镜面定理/镜面映射' with '镜像五次三维流形', and it ventures Chinese characters for the authors ('张怀良–郭帅–李骏').

Complete, accurate and naturally restructured ('数学家发展和研究 Gromov--Witten 理论的动力，来自二十世纪九十年代初 Candelas、de la Ossa、Green 和 Parkes 的工作'). Terminology slips recur: proper is rendered '固有的' ('\(\Mbar_{g,n}(X, \beta)\) 是固有的'), 'annihilated' becomes the physics word '湮灭' instead of the standard '零化', and evaluation morphisms are '取值态射/取值映射' rather than 赋值态射; 'Lefschetz 膜' for thimble is unusual.

Structurally complete with byte-identical math and keys, but two real accuracy blemishes: properness is mistranslated as '在 \(X\) 光滑且射影的假设下，\(\Mbar_{g,n}(X, \beta)\) 是真的', and 'up to various prefactors' becomes the garbled '且在各种前因子范围内'. Terminology policy is inconsistent ('Gromov-Witten' early vs '格罗莫夫-威滕' late, 'Euler 向量场' vs '欧拉向量场', '霍奇' translated while Deligne-Mumford is kept), and 'forget map'/'stabilize' are left untranslated inside \xrightarrow.

Complete with token-identical math and the most consistently translated proper names (格罗莫夫–威滕, 卡拉比–丘, 弗罗贝尼乌斯, 庞加莱, 霍奇); the prose reads like native mathematical Chinese. The one howler is '是\(\Mbar_{g,n}(X, \beta)\) 是真（proper）的' for properness, rescued only by the parenthetical English; smaller issues: 'Lefschetz 闭链' for thimble, 'KdV 族' for KdV hierarchy, and '欧拉向量场' vs 'Euler 向量场' inconsistency.

The most polished reading: properness is correctly '紧合的', and the J-function sentence '因此，计算所有带后代的亏格零 Gromov-Witten 不变量的问题就归结为计算 J 函数的问题' is natural and exact; terminology (环面簇, 万有曲线, 重言类, 伸缩子方程) is consistent and English name-terms are kept uniformly. Minor lapses: '镜像五次流形' drops '三维', the clipped adverbial '在亏格零' (missing 时/下), and 'KdV 族' for hierarchy.

Complete and the most fluent, with helpful English glosses, but the terminology is repeatedly wrong or non-standard: proper becomes '是完备的' (completeness), universal curve/map becomes '泛曲线/泛稳定映射', prestable becomes '前稳定', and '3-自旋曲线', 'KdV 谱系', '度规' are non-standard; worst, 'tautological class/relations' is rendered '典范类（tautological class）/典范关系', i.e. canonical, a different concept. It also moves sentence punctuation inside/outside about 15 display formulas.

Complete and generally faithful, but with a cluster of non-standard renderings: proper as '固有的', universal as '泛曲线/泛稳定映射', '膨胀子位移' for dilaton shift, 'Hodge 结构的变差' for variation, and 'r-自旋曲线' for r-spin curves; '环簇' for toric is loose and 'Lefschetz thimble' is left wholly in English. Fluency is good but stiffer than D/E ('为了让我们的计算更轻松'), and several formula-final periods were moved outside the display math.

Faithful, complete and fluent; all macros, labels and displays are preserved exactly, and it is one of the few to translate the inline math text, rendering the summand line as 「\ab(\text{一个 } 4 \text{ 维的直和项})」.
